words.meaning: usage. 提醒 (某人) 某事
words.exampleEn: My teacher warned us of the coming exam.
words.exampleZh: 老师提醒我们注意即将到来的考试。

words.exampleEn: Regardless of the rain, we finished the football match.
words.exampleZh: 不管下雨，我们还是踢完了球赛。

words.exampleEn: I received a warm letter from my old friend.
words.exampleZh: 我收到老朋友一封热情的来信。

words.exampleEn: At the end, the manager summed up the main points.
words.exampleZh: 最后经理总结了几个要点。

words.exampleEn: Many old trees died from the long dry summer.
words.exampleZh: 许多老树死于漫长干旱的夏季。

words.meaning: usage. 试图做某事，设法做某事
words.exampleEn: Our school seeks to cut waste in the dining hall.
words.exampleZh: 我们学校设法减少食堂的浪费。

words.meaning: prep. 在…前面；prep. 当着…的面，在…面前
words.exampleEn: A yellow bus stopped in front of the school gate.
words.exampleZh: 一辆黄色巴士停在校门前。

words.exampleEn: I got rid of the old magazines last weekend.
words.exampleZh: 上周末我把旧杂志都处理掉了。

words.meaning: usage. 喜欢做某事，享受做某事的乐趣
words.exampleEn: My sister enjoys reading short stories before bed.
words.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢睡前读短篇故事。

words.exampleEn: Both the library and the lab open at eight.
words.exampleZh: 图书馆和实验室都在八点开放。

words.exampleEn: My uncle follows the stock market every morning.
words.exampleZh: 我叔叔每天早上都关注股市。

words.exampleEn: We threw away the broken chairs after the party.
words.exampleZh: 聚会后我们扔掉了几把破椅子。

words.exampleEn: The teacher got the main idea across with a simple drawing.
words.exampleZh: 老师用一幅简图讲清了大意。

words.meaning: usage. 与…相等的，与…相同的；usage. 能胜任…的，能应付…的
words.exampleEn: This blue rope is equal to that one in length.
words.exampleZh: 这根蓝绳和那根长度相等。

words.exampleEn: We hardly ever eat out during the busy week.
words.exampleZh: 忙碌的一周里我们几乎从不外出吃饭。

words.meaning: idm. 尤其，特别，格外；idm. 特殊的，专门的，具体的
words.exampleEn: We loved the local food, the fresh bread in particular.
words.exampleZh: 我们喜欢当地食物，尤其是新鲜面包。

words.meaning: phrv. 从…突然离开，逃跑；phrv. 逃避，回避 (问题或困局)
words.exampleEn: The frightened cat ran away from the loud dog.
words.exampleZh: 受惊的猫从大叫的狗旁逃开了。

words.exampleEn: We planted fresh vegetables such as carrots and beans.
words.exampleZh: 我们种了新鲜蔬菜，比如胡萝卜和豆子。

words.meaning: usage. 集中 (注意力、精力等) 于
words.exampleEn: Our class focused on the new words this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天上午全班集中学了新单词。

words.exampleEn: My cousin went abroad to study medicine last year.
words.exampleZh: 我表弟去年出国学医了。

words.meaning: idm. 在合适的位置，到位；idm. 被启用，在工作
words.exampleEn: All the chairs were in place for the evening show.
words.exampleZh: 所有椅子都为晚会摆放到位了。

words.exampleEn: Due to the heavy fog, our flight left two hours late.
words.exampleZh: 由于大雾，我们的航班晚点两小时起飞。

words.exampleEn: The neighbors complained about the loud music last night.
words.exampleZh: 邻居们抱怨昨晚吵闹的音乐。

words.exampleEn: The box was too heavy for me to lift alone.
words.exampleZh: 箱子太重，我一个人搬不动。

words.exampleEn: We left for the train station early in the morning.
words.exampleZh: 我们一大早就动身去火车站了。

words.meaning: phrv. (在旅馆、机场等) 登记；phrv. 托运 (行李)；phrv. 汇报，了解
words.exampleEn: We checked in at the hotel just after noon.
words.exampleZh: 我们中午后在旅馆登记入住了。

words.exampleEn: Most students were in favor of the new library rules.
words.exampleZh: 多数学生都赞成图书馆的新规定。

words.exampleEn: The little boy pretended to sleep during the game.
words.exampleZh: 小男孩在游戏时假装睡着了。

words.meaning: phrv. 是…的原因；phrv. 解释，说明；phrv. (数量上、比例上) 占
words.exampleEn: Heavy rain accounted for the flood in the small village.
words.exampleZh: 大雨是那个小村庄发洪水的原因。

words.meaning: usage. 阻止某人做某事，防止某事发生
words.exampleEn: The heavy snow stopped us from climbing the hill.
words.exampleZh: 大雪阻止了我们去爬山。

words.meaning: usage. 对…的强调，对…的重视
words.exampleEn: Our school puts strong emphasis on daily reading practice.
words.exampleZh: 我们学校很重视每天的阅读练习。

words.exampleEn: Every volunteer made a contribution to the clean-up day.
words.exampleZh: 每位志愿者都为清扫日活动出了力。

words.exampleEn: A red bus passed by the shop every few minutes.
words.exampleZh: 每隔几分钟就有一辆红巴士经过店门。

words.meaning: idm. 应该做，预计是；idm. 一般认为，人们普遍觉得
words.exampleEn: We are supposed to hand in our homework before class.
words.exampleZh: 我们应该在上课前交作业。

words.meaning: usage. (使) 与…一致，和…相称，符合
words.exampleEn: His calm style fits into our small team well.
words.exampleZh: 他沉稳的风格与我们小团队很相称。

words.exampleEn: The two brothers helped each other with the heavy boxes.
words.exampleZh: 两兄弟互相帮忙搬那些重箱子。

words.meaning: phrv. 出故障，坏掉；失败；垮掉；phrv. 情不自禁地哭起来；phrv. 破坏，消除；phrv. 把…分类；使分解，使变化
words.exampleEn: Our old car broke down on the way to the airport.
words.exampleZh: 我们的旧车在去机场的路上抛锚了。

words.exampleEn: My roommate suggested ordering pizza for our late dinner.
words.exampleZh: 室友提议晚饭点披萨来吃。

words.exampleEn: We view this small garden as a quiet reading corner.
words.exampleZh: 我们把这个小花园看作安静的读书角。

words.meaning: usage. 要么…要么，不是…就是
words.exampleEn: You can take either the bus or the subway downtown.
words.exampleZh: 你可以坐公交或者地铁去市中心。

words.exampleEn: I tried on three coats before choosing the blue one.
words.exampleZh: 我试穿了三件外套才选了蓝色那件。

words.exampleEn: We sat by the lake and rested for a while.
words.exampleZh: 我们在湖边坐下休息了一会儿。

words.meaning: usage. 做完某事，完成某事
words.exampleEn: I finished painting the small wooden shelf yesterday afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 昨天下午我漆完了那个小木架。

words.exampleEn: Before long, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
words.exampleZh: 不久雨停了，太阳也出来了。

words.exampleEn: As long as we keep practicing, our English improves steadily.
words.exampleZh: 只要坚持练习，我们的英语就会稳步提高。

words.exampleEn: Except for a few spelling mistakes, the letter looked perfect.
words.exampleZh: 除了几处拼写错误，这封信看着很完美。

words.exampleEn: She achieved her goal of running five kilometers without stopping.
words.exampleZh: 她达成了不停歇跑五公里的目标。

words.meaning: idm. 倘若没有，若非，要不是；idm. 除了…外
words.exampleEn: But for a few clouds, the sky stayed clear all afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 除了几朵云，天空整个下午都很晴朗。

words.meaning: phrv. 精心挑选；phrv. 辨认出
words.exampleEn: She picked out a plain blue scarf for her mother.
words.exampleZh: 她给母亲精心挑了一条素净的蓝围巾。

words.exampleEn: The children were eager to open their birthday gifts.
words.exampleZh: 孩子们迫不及待想打开生日礼物。

words.exampleEn: We walked home instead of waiting for the crowded bus.
words.exampleZh: 我们走回家，而不是等拥挤的公交。

words.meaning: phrv. 分发，散发；phrv. 发出 (光、信号、声音等)
words.exampleEn: The office sent out fifty invitations for the open day.
words.exampleZh: 办公室为开放日发出了五十份请柬。

words.exampleEn: Many students engage in volunteer work during the holidays.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生在假期参加志愿活动。

words.exampleEn: I regretted selling my old bike so cheaply.
words.exampleZh: 我后悔把旧自行车卖得那么便宜。

words.exampleEn: My neighbor is willing to lend us a ladder.
words.exampleZh: 邻居乐意借给我们一把梯子。

words.meaning: usage. 允许某人做某事；usage. 使某人做某事成为可能
words.exampleEn: The museum allows visitors to take photos without flash.
words.exampleZh: 博物馆允许参观者不开闪光灯拍照。

words.exampleEn: Our class reads an average of three books each month.
words.exampleZh: 我们班平均每月读三本书。

words.meaning: usage. (和…) 一样的事物 (或人)
words.exampleEn: My new bag looks the same as my sister's old one.
words.exampleZh: 我的新包看起来和姐姐的旧包一样。

words.meaning: usage. 和某人共用 (或合用) 某物；usage. 与某人有同样的感情 (或想法等)；usage. 向某人诉说自己的想法 (感情等)；usage. 与某人共同承担，分担 (责任)
words.exampleEn: I shared my umbrella with a stranger at the bus stop.
words.exampleZh: 我在公交站和一位陌生人合撑了伞。

words.exampleEn: We booked the small hotel room two weeks in advance.
words.exampleZh: 我们提前两周订好了那间小旅馆房。

words.meaning: usage. 告诫某人不要做某事
words.exampleEn: The lifeguard warned us not to swim in the deep water.
words.exampleZh: 救生员告诫我们别在深水区游泳。

words.meaning: phrv. 给人以…印象，使产生…印象；phrv. (偶然) 遇见，碰见，发现
words.exampleEn: He comes across as a calm and patient teacher.
words.exampleZh: 他给人的印象是位沉稳耐心的老师。

words.exampleEn: I handed the thank-you card to my teacher in person.
words.exampleZh: 我当面把感谢卡交给了老师。

words.meaning: usage. 知道…的，意识到…的；usage. 察觉到…的，注意到…的
words.exampleEn: Few drivers were aware of the new speed limit.
words.exampleZh: 几乎没有司机意识到新的限速规定。

words.exampleEn: Some old village customs died out over the years.
words.exampleZh: 一些古老的乡村习俗渐渐消失了。

words.exampleEn: I am used to the noisy street outside my window.
words.exampleZh: 我已经习惯窗外喧闹的街道了。

words.meaning: phrv. 摆脱 (某人)，逃离 (某地)
words.exampleEn: We got away from the noisy party early last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚我们早早逃离了吵闹的聚会。

words.meaning: usage. 无…的，不受…伤害 (或影响)
words.exampleEn: The small town is free from heavy traffic and noise.
words.exampleZh: 这座小镇没有拥堵的车流和噪音。

words.exampleEn: I followed my doctor's advice and gave up late-night snacks.
words.exampleZh: 我听从医生的建议，戒掉了夜宵。

words.exampleEn: The kids enjoyed themselves at the beach all afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 孩子们在海滩玩了一下午很开心。

words.meaning: phrv. 关心，替…着想；phrv. 考虑，打算 (做某事)；phrv. 想到，想象；构思出；想起；phrv. 看待
words.exampleEn: A good leader thinks of the whole team first.
words.exampleZh: 好的领导总是先替整个团队着想。

words.exampleEn: After the long walk, we had a rest under a tree.
words.exampleZh: 走了很久后我们在树下歇了一会儿。

words.meaning: usage. 对…确信的，对…有把握的
words.exampleEn: I am quite sure of the answer to this question.
words.exampleZh: 我对这道题的答案很有把握。

words.exampleEn: Daily practice is the key to good spoken English.
words.exampleZh: 每天练习是练好英语口语的关键。

words.meaning: n. 空闲时间，业余时间
words.exampleEn: In my spare time I build small model ships.
words.exampleZh: 空闲时我会做些小船模型。

words.exampleEn: My father kept a promise and fixed my old bike.
words.exampleZh: 父亲信守诺言，修好了我的旧自行车。

words.meaning: phrv. 偶然遇见，碰到 (某人)；phrv. 遇到 (困难等)；phrv. 撞在…上，与…相撞
words.exampleEn: I ran into an old classmate at the train station.
words.exampleZh: 我在火车站偶遇了一位老同学。

words.exampleEn: My grandmother cares about every small detail of the garden.
words.exampleZh: 奶奶在意花园里的每个小细节。

words.exampleEn: Our team cooperated with two local shops last spring.
words.exampleZh: 去年春天我们团队和两家本地店铺合作。

words.exampleEn: We found ourselves in a difficult situation during the trip.
words.exampleZh: 旅途中我们陷入了困难的境地。

words.exampleEn: Our teacher used a short video in place of a long talk.
words.exampleZh: 老师用一段短片代替了长篇讲解。

words.meaning: collocation. 采取措施，采取行动
words.exampleEn: The school took action to fix the broken playground gate.
words.exampleZh: 学校采取行动修好了坏掉的操场大门。

words.meaning: idm. 乍一看；idm. 初次见到
words.exampleEn: At first sight, the old box seemed quite ordinary.
words.exampleZh: 乍一看，那个旧盒子显得很普通。

words.meaning: phrv. 弄懂，弄清楚，想出；phrv. 计算出 (数量或成本)
words.exampleEn: We figured out the simple puzzle in a few minutes.
words.exampleZh: 我们几分钟就弄明白了那道简单的谜题。

words.meaning: phrv. 不包括，不提及，遗漏
words.exampleEn: The list left out two important names by mistake.
words.exampleZh: 那份名单不小心漏掉了两个重要名字。

words.meaning: usage. 回复…，回答…；usage. 对…作出回应
words.exampleEn: I responded to her email with a short thank-you note.
words.exampleZh: 我用一封简短的感谢信回复了她的邮件。

words.exampleEn: No doubt, fresh fruit is good for young children.
words.exampleZh: 毫无疑问，新鲜水果对小孩有益。

words.exampleEn: As for the price, we can talk about it later.
words.exampleZh: 至于价格，我们可以稍后再谈。

words.exampleEn: On account of the storm, the outdoor market closed early.
words.exampleZh: 由于暴风雨，露天市场提前收摊了。

words.meaning: phrv. 提到，谈及；phrv. 指的是，描述，关于；phrv. 参考，查阅
words.exampleEn: Our teacher often refers to healthy habits in class.
words.exampleZh: 老师上课时常谈到健康习惯。

words.meaning: phrv. 依靠，信赖；phrv. 受…的影响，取决于
words.exampleEn: Young plants depend on enough sunlight and water.
words.exampleZh: 幼苗依靠充足的阳光和水分。

words.exampleEn: Too much sugar is bad for your teeth and sleep.
words.exampleZh: 糖吃太多对牙齿和睡眠都有害。

words.exampleEn: She passed on the good news to everyone in the office.
words.exampleZh: 她把好消息传达给了办公室每个人。

words.meaning: usage. 一套，一副，一组 (类似的东西)
words.exampleEn: My aunt bought a set of six matching tea cups.
words.exampleZh: 姑姑买了一套六只配套的茶杯。

words.meaning: phrv. (眼泪、笑声、歌声等)突然爆发
words.exampleEn: The whole class burst into laughter at the funny story.
words.exampleZh: 听到那个有趣的故事全班突然大笑起来。

words.meaning: usage. 使…从…分开；usage. 把…和…隔开；usage. 使…与…分离，使…与…分散；usage. 将…和…区分开
words.exampleEn: I separated the ripe apples from the green ones.
words.exampleZh: 我把熟苹果和青的分开了。

words.meaning: phrv. (战争等) 突然开始，爆发
words.exampleEn: A big fire broke out in the old factory last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚那家旧工厂发生了一场大火。

words.exampleEn: Many students objected to the new school rule.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生反对这条新校规。

words.exampleEn: The hotel charges guests extra for breakfast.
words.exampleZh: 这家酒店向客人额外收早餐费。

words.exampleEn: The child reacted to the loud noise with fear.
words.exampleZh: 孩子对巨响作出了害怕的反应。

words.meaning: usage. 尽某人的最大努力
words.exampleEn: We tried our best to finish the work on time.
words.exampleZh: 我们尽了最大努力按时完成工作。

words.exampleEn: The game stopped because of the heavy rain.
words.exampleZh: 因为下大雨，比赛停止了。

words.meaning: usage. (使) 连接， (使) 联结
words.exampleEn: The worker connected the pipe to the water tank.
words.exampleZh: 工人把管子接到了水箱上。

words.meaning: usage. (使) 变换成，(使) 改换成；usage. 换 (衣服)
words.exampleEn: Warm sunlight changed the ice into water.
words.exampleZh: 温暖的阳光把冰变成了水。

words.exampleEn: The old man sat in the park for a long time.
words.exampleZh: 老人在公园里坐了很长时间。

words.meaning: usage. 倾向于做某事，易于做某事
words.exampleEn: Children tend to catch colds in cold weather.
words.exampleZh: 孩子在冷天容易感冒。

words.exampleEn: She left the door open on purpose.
words.exampleZh: 她故意让门一直开着。

words.exampleEn: The writer based his story on a real event.
words.exampleZh: 作者把故事建立在一个真实事件上。

words.meaning: phrv. 拿起；接电话；(开车) 接人；phrv. 得到，学会；改善，增强；辨认；phrv. 收集；接收 (信号等)；买到；phrv. 感染，得到；找到，跟踪；收拾
words.exampleEn: She picked up the book from the floor.
words.exampleZh: 她从地板上把书捡了起来。

words.exampleEn: Many readers benefited from the clear notes.
words.exampleZh: 许多读者得益于这些清晰的笔记。

words.exampleEn: My friend persuaded me to join the club.
words.exampleZh: 朋友劝说我加入这个俱乐部。

words.exampleEn: Students must keep quiet on campus at night.
words.exampleZh: 学生夜间在校内必须保持安静。

words.meaning: phrv. 使某人参加，使某人从事
words.exampleEn: The teacher engaged the class in a lively discussion.
words.exampleZh: 老师让全班参与了一场热烈的讨论。

words.exampleEn: My pen friend comes from a small mountain village.
words.exampleZh: 我的笔友来自一个小山村。

words.meaning: idm. 与…并驾齐驱，与…步调一致
words.exampleEn: The runner kept pace with the leader for two miles.
words.exampleZh: 这名跑者与领先者并驾齐驱了两英里。

words.exampleEn: We consider this book as a useful guide.
words.exampleZh: 我们把这本书看作一本有用的指南。

words.exampleEn: Classmates should help one another after school.
words.exampleZh: 同学们放学后应该互相帮助。

words.exampleEn: On average, we spend two hours on homework.
words.exampleZh: 我们平均花两小时做作业。

words.exampleEn: The headmaster gave a speech on the first school day.
words.exampleZh: 校长在开学第一天发表了讲话。

words.meaning: usage. 向…暴露，向…显露；usage. 使…遭受 (危险或不快)；usage. 使…接触，使…体验
words.exampleEn: Workers should not expose their eyes to bright light.
words.exampleZh: 工人不应让眼睛暴露在强光下。

words.exampleEn: I heard from my sister after many years.
words.exampleZh: 多年后我收到了姐姐的消息。

words.exampleEn: They intend to build a new library next spring.
words.exampleZh: 他们打算明年春天建一座新图书馆。

words.exampleEn: The new student seems to know everyone already.
words.exampleZh: 这位新同学好像已经认识所有人了。

words.exampleEn: Little kids are curious about everything around them.
words.exampleZh: 小孩子对周围的一切都很好奇。

words.meaning: usage. 铺，铺放 (尤指在地板上)；phrv. 规定，制订 (条例或原则)
words.exampleEn: They laid down a new carpet in the living room.
words.exampleZh: 他们在客厅铺了一块新地毯。

words.meaning: collocation. (过去) 那时，(将来) 到那时
words.exampleEn: He was already a doctor by then.
words.exampleZh: 到那时他已经是一名医生了。

words.exampleEn: She was about to close the classroom window.
words.exampleZh: 她正要关上教室的窗户。

words.exampleEn: Visitors feel free to take photos in this hall.
words.exampleZh: 参观者可以随意在这个大厅拍照。

words.exampleEn: After practice, I was able to swim across the river.
words.exampleZh: 练习之后，我能游过这条河了。

words.meaning: idm. 到目前为止，…得多，最
words.exampleEn: This road is by far the shortest way home.
words.exampleZh: 这条路是迄今最短的回家路线。

words.exampleEn: Neither the teacher nor the students knew the answer.
words.exampleZh: 老师和学生都不知道答案。

words.meaning: usage. 试图做 (尤指做困难的事)
words.exampleEn: The climbers attempted to reach the top before dark.
words.exampleZh: 登山者试图在天黑前登上山顶。

words.meaning: usage. 一定会做 (或发生某事)；idm. 务必做某事，一定要做某事
words.exampleEn: Careful planning is sure to save time later.
words.exampleZh: 周密的计划日后一定会节省时间。

words.exampleEn: The two plans differ in one important respect.
words.exampleZh: 这两个计划在一个重要方面不同。

words.meaning: phrv. 返回，回去；phrv. 找回，拿回
words.exampleEn: We got back home late after the long trip.
words.exampleZh: 长途旅行后我们很晚才回到家。

words.meaning: phrv. 帮助…摆脱 (困境)，帮助…做事
words.exampleEn: My cousin helped out with the housework yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 昨天表弟帮忙做了家务。

words.meaning: usage. 鼓励某人做某事；usage. 怂恿某人做某事；usage. 促使某人做某事
words.exampleEn: The coach encouraged the team to try again.
words.exampleZh: 教练鼓励队伍再试一次。

words.meaning: phrv. 照顾，照料某人；phrv. 深爱，非常喜欢某人
words.exampleEn: She cared for her sick mother at home.
words.exampleZh: 她在家照顾生病的母亲。

words.exampleEn: To our surprise, the shy boy won the race.
words.exampleZh: 令我们惊讶的是，那个害羞的男孩赢了比赛。

words.exampleEn: He looked calm, but in reality he felt afraid.
words.exampleZh: 他看起来平静，实际上却很害怕。

words.exampleEn: All students handed in their papers before noon.
words.exampleZh: 所有学生都在中午前交了试卷。

words.meaning: collocation. 在最近几年中，近年来
words.exampleEn: In recent years, more families bought small cars.
words.exampleZh: 近年来更多家庭购买了小汽车。

words.meaning: collocation. 在视野之外，在看不见的地方
words.exampleEn: The plane flew out of sight behind the clouds.
words.exampleZh: 飞机飞到云后看不见了。

words.meaning: usage. 可能遭受…影响的；usage. 取决于，视…而定；usage. 遵守，受…支配
words.exampleEn: This area is subject to heavy floods in summer.
words.exampleZh: 这个地区夏天容易遭受严重洪水。

words.exampleEn: She attributed her success to hard daily practice.
words.exampleZh: 她把成功归因于每天刻苦的练习。

words.meaning: phrv. 拿走，带走；消除 (痛苦等)
words.exampleEn: The waitress took away our empty plates.
words.exampleZh: 女服务员拿走了我们的空盘子。

words.exampleEn: The cook combined fresh fruit with cold milk.
words.exampleZh: 厨师把新鲜水果和冷牛奶混合在一起。

words.exampleEn: He acts as if he owns the whole office.
words.exampleZh: 他表现得好像整间办公室都是他的。

words.exampleEn: Too much sugar does harm to young teeth.
words.exampleZh: 太多糖会对小孩的牙齿造成伤害。

words.exampleEn: I bought a couple of notebooks at the shop.
words.exampleZh: 我在商店买了两本笔记本。

words.meaning: usage. 与…相对立的，与…相反的
words.exampleEn: His actions were contrary to his kind words.
words.exampleZh: 他的行为与他的好话相反。

words.meaning: usage. 经受 (疼痛、疾病)；usage. 遭受，蒙受 (不愉快的事)
words.exampleEn: My grandmother suffers from a bad backache.
words.exampleZh: 我奶奶患有严重的背痛。

words.meaning: phrv. (某物) 被用完，被耗尽；phrv. 用完，耗尽 (某物)
words.exampleEn: Our drinking water ran out on the third day.
words.exampleZh: 我们的饮用水在第三天用完了。

words.meaning: phrv. 把…放到一旁 (或搁到一边)；phrv. 省出，留出 (钱或时间)；phrv. 暂时不考虑，把…先放一放
words.exampleEn: She set aside the newspaper on the table.
words.exampleZh: 她把报纸搁在桌子一旁。

words.meaning: phrv. 由…组成 (或构成)，包括
words.exampleEn: The team consists of ten young players.
words.exampleZh: 这支队伍由十名年轻队员组成。

words.meaning: usage. 回避做某事，避免 (坏事发生)
words.exampleEn: We avoided driving through the busy city center.
words.exampleZh: 我们避免开车穿过繁忙的市中心。

words.meaning: idm. 当初，一开始；idm. (用于句首) 第一
words.exampleEn: I did not want to move here in the first place.
words.exampleZh: 当初我就不想搬到这里来。

words.exampleEn: A few students stayed to clean the classroom.
words.exampleZh: 几个学生留下来打扫教室。

words.exampleEn: The manager is in charge of the whole sales team.
words.exampleZh: 经理负责整个销售团队。

words.exampleEn: Our small room was full of old books.
words.exampleZh: 我们的小屋里满是旧书。

words.meaning: phrv. 把…抛在后面，超过；phrv. 永久离开 (某人、某地或某国)；collocation. 忘了带，丢下
words.exampleEn: The fast runner left the others far behind.
words.exampleZh: 那位快跑者把其他人远远甩在后面。

words.meaning: phrv. 妨碍某事，干扰某事；phrv. 弄坏 (器材等)
words.exampleEn: Loud music interfered with my reading last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚吵闹的音乐干扰了我的阅读。

words.exampleEn: I agree with you to some extent.
words.exampleZh: 在某种程度上我同意你的看法。

words.meaning: idm. 改变某人的决定 (或看法、主意)
words.exampleEn: My father changed his mind about the family trip.
words.exampleZh: 我父亲改变了关于家庭旅行的主意。

words.exampleEn: The judge took his young age into account.
words.exampleZh: 法官考虑到了他年纪还小。

words.exampleEn: Children show a strong interest in wild animals.
words.exampleZh: 孩子们对野生动物表现出浓厚兴趣。

words.meaning: usage. 搜寻，查找，搜查；usage. 思索，细想 (问题答案等)
words.exampleEn: We searched for the lost key in the garden.
words.exampleZh: 我们在花园里搜寻丢失的钥匙。

words.meaning: usage. 通知，告知某人某事
words.exampleEn: The nurse informed us of the visiting hours.
words.exampleZh: 护士把探视时间通知了我们。

words.meaning: collocation. 取得进步，取得进展
words.exampleEn: My little brother made progress in math this term.
words.exampleZh: 我弟弟这学期数学取得了进步。

words.meaning: idm. 为某人好，为了帮助某人
words.exampleEn: I explained the plan again for her benefit.
words.exampleZh: 为了帮她，我又把计划讲了一遍。

words.meaning: idm. 从各方面考虑，总的说来
words.exampleEn: All in all, the trip was cheap and fun.
words.exampleZh: 总的说来，这趟旅行又便宜又有趣。

words.meaning: phrv. 粉碎，破碎；破裂，结束；phrv. 解散，散会；phrv. 拆开，打散；phrv. 分手，绝交
words.exampleEn: A wooden ship broke up in the heavy storm.
words.exampleZh: 一艘木船在暴风雨中碎裂了。

words.exampleEn: His doctor urged him to take more exercise.
words.exampleZh: 他的医生敦促他多做运动。

words.exampleEn: Our new library is not yet open to students.
words.exampleZh: 我们的新图书馆还没有对学生开放。

words.meaning: collocation. 进入 (某地)；到达，被收到；phrv. (赛跑比赛中) 取得 (某名次)；phrv. 变时髦，时兴，流行；phrv. 在…中起作用，参与；涨潮
words.exampleEn: Yesterday the train came in ten minutes late.
words.exampleZh: 昨天火车晚点十分钟到达。

words.exampleEn: We consider this plan to be a safe choice.
words.exampleZh: 我们认为这个计划是稳妥的选择。

words.meaning: usage. 设法做某事，尽力做某事
words.exampleEn: I tried to call her twice this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天上午我试着给她打了两次电话。

words.exampleEn: The school took measures to keep students safe.
words.exampleZh: 学校采取措施保障学生安全。

words.exampleEn: Email is a cheap means of communication.
words.exampleZh: 电子邮件是一种便宜的沟通方式。

words.exampleEn: He finished the work long before the deadline.
words.exampleZh: 他早在截止日期前就完成了工作。

words.meaning: phrv. 听说，得知；usage. 听说，得知
words.exampleEn: We heard about the new shop from a neighbor.
words.exampleZh: 我们从邻居那里听说了这家新店。

words.exampleEn: The driver sped up on the wide empty road.
words.exampleZh: 司机在宽阔空旷的路上加快了速度。

words.meaning: usage. 把…从…拿开 (或移除)；usage. 把…从…去除 (或排除)
words.exampleEn: She removed the dirty cup from the desk.
words.exampleZh: 她把脏杯子从桌上拿走了。

words.exampleEn: A number of guests arrived before the show.
words.exampleZh: 演出前到了一些客人。

words.meaning: phrv. (因工作不多而) 解雇；phrv. 停止做，停止使用
words.exampleEn: The factory laid off twenty workers last winter.
words.exampleZh: 工厂去年冬天解雇了二十名工人。

words.exampleEn: This old machine is still in use today.
words.exampleZh: 这台旧机器如今仍在使用中。

words.meaning: phrv. 涉及，关于；phrv. 产生共鸣，与…有同感
words.exampleEn: The new rules relate to school safety only.
words.exampleZh: 这些新规定只涉及校园安全。

words.meaning: usage. 与…建立密切关系，尽力理解
words.exampleEn: Good teachers engage with every student in class.
words.exampleZh: 好老师会努力和班里每个学生沟通。

words.exampleEn: In addition, the ticket includes a free drink.
words.exampleZh: 此外，这张票还包含一杯免费饮料。

words.meaning: usage. 远离…；idm. 远非…，完全不…
words.exampleEn: The village lies far from the busy city.
words.exampleZh: 这个村庄远离繁忙的城市。

words.meaning: usage. 使某人能够做某事
words.exampleEn: The map enabled us to find the small village.
words.exampleZh: 这张地图使我们找到了那个小村庄。

words.meaning: collocation. 陷入困境，惹上麻烦
words.exampleEn: He got into trouble for breaking the window.
words.exampleZh: 他因为打破窗户惹上了麻烦。

words.meaning: collocation. 在…的开头，在…的起点
words.exampleEn: At the beginning of the term, we made a study plan.
words.exampleZh: 学期开始时我们制定了学习计划。

words.meaning: usage. 到达 (某地) ，寄到 (某地)
words.exampleEn: We arrived at the small station before noon.
words.exampleZh: 我们中午前到达了那个小站。

words.meaning: usage. 阻止某人做某事，防止…发生
words.exampleEn: The heavy rain prevented us from leaving the camp.
words.exampleZh: 大雨阻止了我们离开营地。

words.exampleEn: My brother helped me fix the broken bike.
words.exampleZh: 哥哥帮我修好了坏自行车。

words.meaning: idm. 与…毫不相干，与…无关
words.exampleEn: That rumor has nothing to do with our team.
words.exampleZh: 那个传闻与我们队毫不相干。

words.exampleEn: She refused to answer the rude question.
words.exampleZh: 她拒绝回答那个无礼的问题。

words.meaning: idm. 保持联系；idm. 了解…的最新情况
words.exampleEn: Old classmates keep in touch by email.
words.exampleZh: 老同学通过电子邮件保持联系。

words.meaning: usage. 授予 (或奖励) 某人某物
words.exampleEn: The school awarded Mary a small prize.
words.exampleZh: 学校授予玛丽一份小奖品。

words.exampleEn: Volunteers handed out leaflets at the gate.
words.exampleZh: 志愿者在门口分发传单。

words.exampleEn: The museum lets children in for free.
words.exampleZh: 博物馆让儿童免费入内。

words.exampleEn: Please stay away from the busy road.
words.exampleZh: 请远离那条繁忙的马路。

words.meaning: usage. 感觉像是…；usage. 给人一种像…的感觉；idm. 想要某物，想要做某事
words.exampleEn: With the windows open, it feels like summer.
words.exampleZh: 开着窗户感觉像是夏天。

words.exampleEn: Our class raised money for a sick child.
words.exampleZh: 我们班为一名生病儿童筹款。

words.meaning: phrv. 收留，收养；phrv. 吸入，吞入 (体内)；理解，领会；phrv. 观看；phrv. 欺骗，蒙骗
words.exampleEn: The kind family took in a homeless cat.
words.exampleZh: 那户好心人家收留了一只流浪猫。

words.exampleEn: Make sure you bring your ticket tomorrow.
words.exampleZh: 确保你明天带上车票。

words.meaning: usage. 和某人说话 (或谈话)
words.exampleEn: I talked with my teacher after class.
words.exampleZh: 课后我和老师谈了谈。

words.meaning: phrv. 继续前进；phrv. 继续做，坚持做下去
words.exampleEn: We carried on along the muddy path.
words.exampleZh: 我们沿着泥泞的小路继续前进。

words.exampleEn: At last, the bus came around the corner.
words.exampleZh: 公交车终于从拐角处驶来。

words.exampleEn: The job is not hard; on the contrary, it is fun.
words.exampleZh: 这活儿不难，正相反，还挺有趣。

words.meaning: idm. (告别用语) 走好，保重；idm. 小心，当心
words.exampleEn: Take care, and call me soon.
words.exampleZh: 保重，回头给我打电话。

words.exampleEn: I hope to work in a big city in the future.
words.exampleZh: 我希望将来在大城市工作。

words.meaning: idm. 难怪，怪不得，不足为奇
words.exampleEn: No wonder the boy looks so tired today.
words.exampleZh: 难怪这男孩今天看起来这么累。

words.exampleEn: Sadly, that is the case with many old houses.
words.exampleZh: 遗憾的是许多老房子确实如此。

words.meaning: phrv. 被录取；(尤指费力地) 穿上；phrv. 开始从事 (某职业)；phrv. 参与，开始；陷入 (麻烦等)；phrv. 养成某种习惯；对…产生兴趣
words.exampleEn: Lily got into a famous university last summer.
words.exampleZh: 莉莉去年夏天被一所名牌大学录取。

words.meaning: usage. 比…更好的；usage. (在级别或重要性上) 比…更高的
words.exampleEn: This cheap pen is superior to that expensive one.
words.exampleZh: 这支便宜笔比那支贵的好。

words.exampleEn: Quite a few students joined the art club.
words.exampleZh: 相当多的学生加入了美术社。

words.meaning: usage. 数以千计的，成千上万的
words.exampleEn: Thousands of birds fly south every autumn.
words.exampleZh: 每年秋天成千上万的鸟南飞。

words.exampleEn: Expensive food is not necessarily healthy food.
words.exampleZh: 贵的食物未必是健康食物。

words.exampleEn: As to the price, we can decide tomorrow.
words.exampleZh: 至于价格，我们可以明天再定。

words.meaning: idm. 目的在于，为了，以便
words.exampleEn: He spoke slowly in order that everyone could follow.
words.exampleZh: 他讲得很慢，以便大家都能听懂。

words.exampleEn: In my opinion, the plan needs more time.
words.exampleZh: 在我看来，这个计划需要更多时间。

words.meaning: usage. 限制，限定；phrv. 使某事只在…存在 (或发生)；usage. 限量，减量
words.exampleEn: Please limit your speech to five minutes.
words.exampleZh: 请把发言限制在五分钟内。

words.meaning: phrv. 使活跃，使清醒；usage. 醒来，叫醒
words.exampleEn: A cup of strong tea wakes me up each morning.
words.exampleZh: 每天早上一杯浓茶让我清醒。

words.exampleEn: We visited several places of interest in the old town.
words.exampleZh: 我们游览了老城区的几处名胜古迹。

words.meaning: phrv. 出发，动身，启程；phrv. 使 (炸弹、烟花等) 爆炸；phrv. 触响 (警报)，使 (警报) 响起；phrv. 引发，激起 (尤指意外事件)
words.exampleEn: We set off for the airport before sunrise.
words.exampleZh: 我们日出前动身去机场。

words.meaning: usage. 准备好 (做某事) 的
words.exampleEn: The team is ready for the final match.
words.exampleZh: 队伍已为决赛做好准备。

words.exampleEn: These old boots wore out after one winter.
words.exampleZh: 这双旧靴子一个冬天就穿破了。

words.exampleEn: The guide acquainted us with the local rules.
words.exampleZh: 导游使我们熟悉了当地规定。

words.exampleEn: The children left toys all over the room.
words.exampleZh: 孩子们把玩具丢得满屋都是。

words.meaning: usage. 可被…获得的，可被…买到的
words.exampleEn: Free tickets are available to all students.
words.exampleZh: 所有学生都能拿到免费票。

words.meaning: phrv. 需要某物；phrv. (公开) 要求某事
words.exampleEn: This old bridge calls for quick repair.
words.exampleZh: 这座旧桥需要尽快维修。

words.meaning: usage. 吸引某人，引起某人的兴趣；usage. 向某人呼吁，恳请某人
words.exampleEn: Bright colors appeal to young children.
words.exampleZh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引小孩子。

words.exampleEn: I met an old friend the other day.
words.exampleZh: 几天前我遇见了一位老朋友。

words.meaning: usage. 买得起，负担得起；usage. 承担得起，经得起
words.exampleEn: We cannot afford to buy a new car now.
words.exampleZh: 我们现在买不起新车。

words.exampleEn: The shop sells bread, milk, eggs and so on.
words.exampleZh: 这家店卖面包、牛奶、鸡蛋等等。

words.exampleEn: Ticket prices vary from season to season.
words.exampleZh: 票价随季节而变化。

words.meaning: idm. 可以，当然行，没问题
words.exampleEn: By all means, you may use my laptop today.
words.exampleZh: 当然行，你今天可以用我的电脑。

words.exampleEn: Everyone joined in the games after lunch.
words.exampleZh: 午饭后大家都参加了游戏。

words.exampleEn: The hotel provides guests with free breakfast.
words.exampleZh: 酒店为客人提供免费早餐。

words.exampleEn: More and more families keep a small garden.
words.exampleZh: 越来越多的家庭拥有小花园。

words.exampleEn: It is no use waiting for the last bus.
words.exampleZh: 等末班公交车已经没有意义。

words.exampleEn: Good teachers have an influence on their students.
words.exampleZh: 好老师对学生有影响力。

words.meaning: phrv. (太阳、月亮等) 出现；开花；phrv. 出版，发表；(消息等) 被获知；phrv. 说出，讲出；公开表明；phrv. 结果是，结局是
words.exampleEn: The sun came out after the heavy storm.
words.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后太阳出来了。

words.exampleEn: Anna took my place on the debate team.
words.exampleZh: 安娜代替我加入了辩论队。

words.exampleEn: The bell rang again and again that morning.
words.exampleZh: 那天早上铃一再响起。

words.meaning: phrv. 支持住，承受住；支撑，举起；phrv. 耽搁，阻延；phrv. 举出 (例子)， (作为榜样) 提出；phrv. 持枪抢劫
words.exampleEn: Two strong beams hold up the old roof.
words.exampleZh: 两根结实的梁支撑着旧屋顶。

words.meaning: idm. 作为回报，作为交换；idm. 作为回应
words.exampleEn: I helped him move, and he cooked dinner in return.
words.exampleZh: 我帮他搬家，他做晚饭作为回报。

words.meaning: usage. 未能做成某事；usage. 未履行某事
words.exampleEn: They failed to finish the work on time.
words.exampleZh: 他们未能按时完成工作。

words.exampleEn: The two cousins have a lot in common.
words.exampleZh: 这对表兄弟有很多共同之处。

words.exampleEn: Many beginners have trouble pronouncing this word.
words.exampleZh: 许多初学者发这个音有困难。

words.exampleEn: Your handwriting is similar to your mother's.
words.exampleZh: 你的笔迹和你母亲的很像。

words.meaning: idm. 由某人决定，是某人的职责
words.exampleEn: It is up to you to choose the seat.
words.exampleZh: 由你来决定选哪个座位。

words.meaning: usage. 专门研究 (或从事) ，专攻
words.exampleEn: This small clinic specializes in eye care.
words.exampleZh: 这家小诊所专攻眼部护理。

words.meaning: phrv. 铺开，摆开；phrv. 布置，安排；phrv. 清晰谨慎地提出 (计划、论点等)；phrv. 花钱
words.exampleEn: She laid out the maps on the big table.
words.exampleZh: 她把地图铺开在大桌子上。

words.exampleEn: The child ate nothing but rice all day.
words.exampleZh: 这孩子一整天只吃了米饭。

words.exampleEn: Let us take a break after this long meeting.
words.exampleZh: 长会之后我们休息一下吧。

words.meaning: phrv. (想法或主意) 被想到
words.exampleEn: A good idea suddenly occurred to me.
words.exampleZh: 我突然想到一个好主意。

words.exampleEn: At present, our library has no free seats.
words.exampleZh: 目前我们图书馆没有空座。

words.exampleEn: There is no need to hurry to the station.
words.exampleZh: 没必要急匆匆赶去车站。

words.exampleEn: City workers often long for a quiet weekend.
words.exampleZh: 城里上班族常渴望安静的周末。

words.exampleEn: Some students stay up late before exams.
words.exampleZh: 有些学生考试前熬夜。

words.exampleEn: Nobody can force you to accept the offer.
words.exampleZh: 没人能强迫你接受这个提议。

words.exampleEn: The manager described the new rules in detail.
words.exampleZh: 经理详细说明了新规定。

words.meaning: usage. (时间或空间) 在…前；usage. 比…提前；usage. 领先于
words.exampleEn: A small dog ran ahead of the group.
words.exampleZh: 一只小狗跑在队伍前面。

words.exampleEn: Tom often helps his sister with her math.
words.exampleZh: 汤姆常帮妹妹辅导数学。

words.exampleEn: The old bike is still in good condition.
words.exampleZh: 那辆旧自行车状况仍然良好。

words.meaning: phrv. 实施 (计划)，兑现 (诺言)；phrv. 完成 (任务)
words.exampleEn: We carried out the plan step by step.
words.exampleZh: 我们一步步实施了那个计划。

words.exampleEn: I have no idea about his decision.
words.exampleZh: 我对他的决定毫不知情。

words.exampleEn: After all, we are only beginners.
words.exampleZh: 毕竟我们只是新手。

words.meaning: phrv. 把 (权力或责任) 移交；phrv. 把…正式交给 (某人)
words.exampleEn: The old manager handed over his duties last week.
words.exampleZh: 老经理上周移交了职责。

words.exampleEn: Dark clouds are likely to bring more rain.
words.exampleZh: 乌云很可能带来更多降雨。

words.meaning: usage. 把…增加到；usage. 补充；usage. 给…添加 (特色)
words.exampleEn: Add a little salt to the soup, please.
words.exampleZh: 请往汤里加一点盐。

words.exampleEn: Take a map in case you lose your way.
words.exampleZh: 带张地图，以防迷路。

words.meaning: idm. 通常，在多数情况下；idm. 整体上看，总体来说
words.exampleEn: In general, buses run on time in this city.
words.exampleZh: 通常这座城市的公交车很准时。

words.meaning: phrv. (飞机) 起飞；匆匆离去；phrv. (产品等) 突然成功，迅速走红；phrv. 脱下 (衣服)，摘掉；phrv. 休假，请假
words.exampleEn: The plane took off despite the thick fog.
words.exampleZh: 尽管雾很大，飞机还是起飞了。

words.exampleEn: Grandpa often speaks of his school days.
words.exampleZh: 爷爷常谈起他的学生时代。

words.exampleEn: A series of mistakes delayed the whole project.
words.exampleZh: 一连串失误耽误了整个项目。

words.meaning: usage. 对…的坚决要求；usage. (对商品、服务等的) 需要，要求
words.exampleEn: The workers made a demand for higher pay.
words.exampleZh: 工人们坚决要求提高工资。

words.exampleEn: She translated the short poem into plain English.
words.exampleZh: 她把这首短诗译成了简明英语。

words.meaning: idm. 为了做某事，目的是
words.exampleEn: We left early in order to avoid the traffic.
words.exampleZh: 为了避开堵车我们早出发了。

words.exampleEn: Under no circumstances should children play near the river.
words.exampleZh: 无论如何孩子都不可在河边玩。

words.exampleEn: Heavy traffic was a reason for the delay.
words.exampleZh: 交通拥堵是延误的一个原因。

words.exampleEn: Please send the report at once.
words.exampleZh: 请立刻把报告发出去。

words.exampleEn: Ever since that day, they never spoke again.
words.exampleZh: 从那天起他们再没说过话。

words.meaning: usage. 献身于…，致力于…；usage. 把…用于…
words.exampleEn: She devoted her whole life to village education.
words.exampleZh: 她把一生献给了乡村教育。

words.meaning: usage. 准备好做某事；usage. 愿意做某事
words.exampleEn: The nurses are ready to start the morning shift.
words.exampleZh: 护士们已准备好开始早班。

words.exampleEn: I made an appointment with the dentist yesterday afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 我昨天下午预约了牙医。

words.meaning: idm. 照顾，爱护；负责，处理
words.exampleEn: My sister takes care of our little brother every evening.
words.exampleZh: 我姐姐每天晚上照顾弟弟。

words.meaning: usage. 区分 A 和 B
words.exampleEn: Can you tell a goat from a sheep?
words.exampleZh: 你能区分山羊和绵羊吗？

words.exampleEn: His explanation did not make sense to the whole class.
words.exampleZh: 他的解释全班都觉得讲不通。

words.meaning: usage. (短暂地) 拜访某人；phrv. 要求，呼吁
words.exampleEn: We called on our old teacher last Sunday morning.
words.exampleZh: 我们上周日去拜访了以前的老师。

words.meaning: usage. 在…上花费 (钱、时间或精力)
words.exampleEn: She spent two hundred yuan on a new schoolbag.
words.exampleZh: 她在新书包上花了两百元。

words.meaning: usage. (从监禁或管制中) 逃跑，逃出；usage. (从危险处境中) 逃脱，摆脱
words.exampleEn: Two prisoners escaped from the small village jail last night.
words.exampleZh: 两名囚犯昨晚从村里小监狱逃跑了。

words.meaning: idm. 为了做某事，以便做某事
words.exampleEn: He got up early so as to catch the first bus.
words.exampleZh: 他起得很早，以便赶上首班车。

words.meaning: collocation. 是否…；collocation. 不管，无论
words.exampleEn: I am not sure whether or not the shop opens today.
words.exampleZh: 我不确定这家店今天是否开门。

words.exampleEn: This box is as heavy as that wooden desk.
words.exampleZh: 这个箱子和那张木桌一样重。

words.exampleEn: He made a mistake in the final math problem.
words.exampleZh: 他在最后一道数学题上犯了错。

words.exampleEn: My uncle retired from the factory at sixty.
words.exampleZh: 我叔叔六十岁时从工厂退休了。

words.meaning: idm. 几乎；idm. 大概，大约
words.exampleEn: The two plans are more or less the same.
words.exampleZh: 这两个方案几乎一模一样。

words.exampleEn: We bought ten chairs in all for the new office.
words.exampleZh: 我们给新办公室总共买了十把椅子。

words.exampleEn: Parents often worry about their children's health in winter.
words.exampleZh: 冬天父母常为孩子的健康担心。

words.meaning: phrv. (尤指临时) 建起，竖起；phrv. 安装好，调试好；安排，策划；phrv. 成立 (公司、机构等)；phrv. 使某人更健康 (或精力旺盛)
words.exampleEn: We set up a tent near the lake before dark.
words.exampleZh: 天黑前我们在湖边搭起了帐篷。

words.exampleEn: He worked hard, and as a result, he passed the exam.
words.exampleZh: 他努力学习，因此顺利通过了考试。

words.exampleEn: The teacher gave me useful advice on writing essays.
words.exampleZh: 老师给了我写作文的实用建议。

words.exampleEn: She cut a piece of bread for her little son.
words.exampleZh: 她给小儿子切了一片面包。

words.meaning: usage. 回到…；usage. 恢复到…的状态；usage. 重新开始做某事
words.exampleEn: We returned to the hotel after the long walk.
words.exampleZh: 长途步行后我们回到了旅馆。

words.exampleEn: For instance, our school holds a sports meet each spring.
words.exampleZh: 例如，我们学校每年春天举办运动会。

words.meaning: idm. 使用，利用 (以谋私利等)
words.exampleEn: We made use of the old boxes as bookshelves.
words.exampleZh: 我们把旧箱子用作书架了。

words.meaning: idm. 借助…手段，依靠…方法
words.exampleEn: Farmers water the fields by means of a long pipe.
words.exampleZh: 农民借助一根长水管浇灌田地。

words.exampleEn: This rule is true of all the students in our class.
words.exampleZh: 这条规定适用于我们班所有学生。

words.meaning: idm. 起伏，上下波动；idm. 来来回回，往返地；idm. 时好时坏
words.exampleEn: The little boat moved up and down on the waves.
words.exampleZh: 小船在波浪上上下起伏。

words.exampleEn: My aunt lost weight by walking every morning.
words.exampleZh: 我姑姑靠每天早晨散步减了肥。

words.exampleEn: Tom, along with his classmates, visited the science museum.
words.exampleZh: 汤姆和同学一起参观了科技馆。

words.exampleEn: She gave up the trip for the sake of her sick mother.
words.exampleZh: 为了生病的母亲，她放弃了旅行。

words.exampleEn: We regard this old tree as a dear friend.
words.exampleZh: 我们把这棵老树视为珍爱的朋友。

words.meaning: usage. 达到，进入 (某种状态)；phrv. (想法等) 出现在某人的头脑里；phrv. 合计，共计，总共；phrv. 达到 (某状况，尤指坏的局面)
words.exampleEn: We came to a conclusion after comparing the two plans.
words.exampleZh: 比较两份方案后我们得出了结论。

words.exampleEn: My grandfather used to walk to school in the countryside.
words.exampleZh: 我爷爷过去常常走路上学。

words.meaning: collocation. 在穷困中，在危难中
words.exampleEn: We gave warm coats to families in need last winter.
words.exampleZh: 去年冬天我们把棉衣送给贫困家庭。

words.meaning: usage. 对…负责的，对…承担义务的；usage. 对…应承担责任的；usage. 引起…的，导致…的
words.exampleEn: Our monitor is responsible for collecting the homework every day.
words.exampleZh: 我们班长负责每天收作业。

words.meaning: idm. 换句话说，也就是说，换言之
words.exampleEn: This plan is, in other words, a waste of time.
words.exampleZh: 换句话说，这个计划就是浪费时间。

words.meaning: collocation. 与…有矛盾，在…方面有麻烦
words.exampleEn: I had trouble with the last math question yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 昨天最后那道数学题把我难住了。

words.meaning: usage. 同意某事，应允某事；usage. 约定某事
words.exampleEn: The two sides agreed on a fair price for the car.
words.exampleZh: 双方就这辆车的合理价格达成了一致。

words.exampleEn: Late nights have a bad effect on your memory.
words.exampleZh: 熬夜对你的记忆力有不好的影响。

words.exampleEn: The baby fell asleep during the long train ride.
words.exampleZh: 宝宝在长途火车上睡着了。

words.meaning: collocation. 在…的环境下，在…的条件下
words.exampleEn: Plants grow well under warm and wet conditions.
words.exampleZh: 植物在温暖潮湿的环境下长得好。

words.exampleEn: His gift was nothing more than a small paper card.
words.exampleZh: 他的礼物不过是一张小纸卡。

words.exampleEn: I meant to buy some milk on my way home.
words.exampleZh: 我打算回家路上买些牛奶。

words.exampleEn: He paid back fifty yuan to his friend yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 他昨天把五十元还给了朋友。

words.meaning: idm. 在船上 (或飞机上、火车上)；idm. 支持
words.exampleEn: All the passengers were on board before sunrise.
words.exampleZh: 日出前所有乘客都已登船。

words.meaning: phrv. 信任 (某人)；phrv. 相信…有用；phrv. 相信…的存在
words.exampleEn: We believe in our coach and follow his advice.
words.exampleZh: 我们信任教练，听从他的建议。

words.meaning: phrv. 使 (数量) 增加，使 (规模) 扩大
words.exampleEn: New students added to the size of our club.
words.exampleZh: 新同学让我们社团的规模扩大了。

words.exampleEn: We hunted for the lost key all over the house.
words.exampleZh: 我们在屋里到处找那把丢了的钥匙。

words.exampleEn: The school art show took place in the big hall.
words.exampleZh: 校园艺术展在大礼堂举行了。

words.exampleEn: He showed off his new watch to every classmate.
words.exampleZh: 他向每个同学炫耀自己的新手表。

words.exampleEn: We prepared for the final exam during the holiday.
words.exampleZh: 假期里我们为期末考试做准备。

words.exampleEn: She did her best to finish the work before dark.
words.exampleZh: 她尽了全力在天黑前完成工作。

words.meaning: idm. 很受欢迎，需求量大
words.exampleEn: Warm coats are in great demand in cold winter.
words.exampleZh: 寒冬里保暖外套需求量很大。

words.meaning: usage. 恢复健康，痊愈；usage. 复原，恢复常态
words.exampleEn: He recovered from a bad cold after a week.
words.exampleZh: 一周后他从重感冒中痊愈了。

words.exampleEn: We hoped for sunny weather during the school trip.
words.exampleZh: 我们盼着学校旅行期间天气晴朗。

words.exampleEn: She had difficulty in spelling these long English words.
words.exampleZh: 她拼这些长英语单词有困难。

words.exampleEn: The shop did not open until nine in the morning.
words.exampleZh: 这家店直到早上九点才开门。

words.exampleEn: Once again, our class won the cleaning prize.
words.exampleZh: 我们班又一次拿到了卫生奖。

words.exampleEn: The small shop made a good profit last year.
words.exampleZh: 这家小店去年盈利不少。

words.exampleEn: In case of fire, leave the building at once.
words.exampleZh: 万一发生火灾，立刻离开大楼。

words.exampleEn: She continued reading the novel after dinner.
words.exampleZh: 晚饭后她继续读那本小说。

words.meaning: usage. 自己取 (尤指食物等)
words.exampleEn: Please help yourself to some fruit on the table.
words.exampleZh: 请随便吃桌上的水果。

words.meaning: usage. 关于…的研究 (或调查)；usage. 对…做研究 (或调查)
words.exampleEn: Our teacher did research into the local river pollution.
words.exampleZh: 我们老师做了关于当地河流污染的研究。

words.meaning: usage. 告诉某人关于…的事
words.exampleEn: Dad told us about his childhood in the small village.
words.exampleZh: 爸爸给我们讲了他小村庄里的童年。

words.exampleEn: This old bus no longer runs along the river road.
words.exampleZh: 这辆旧公交不再沿河路跑了。

words.exampleEn: My neighbor lent me a hand with the heavy boxes.
words.exampleZh: 邻居帮我搬了那些重箱子。

words.exampleEn: Many students participated in the school singing contest.
words.exampleZh: 很多同学参加了校园歌唱比赛。

words.meaning: usage. 为…担心的，为…焦虑的
words.exampleEn: Mom was worried about my fever last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚妈妈为我的发烧很担心。

words.meaning: phrv. 聘用，雇用；phrv. 开始呈现 (某种特征、外观等)；phrv. 承担 (责任)，同意负责 (工作)；phrv. 接纳 (乘客)，装载
words.exampleEn: The factory took on twenty new workers in March.
words.exampleZh: 这家工厂三月份雇了二十名新工人。

words.exampleEn: He lay down on the sofa after the long drive.
words.exampleZh: 长途开车后他躺在沙发上。

words.exampleEn: I do not know whether he comes by bus or bike.
words.exampleZh: 我不知道他是坐公交还是骑车来。

words.meaning: usage. 进入 (权)，进入…的通道；usage. 查阅 (或使用) 的机会 (或权利)
words.exampleEn: Students have access to the school library after class.
words.exampleZh: 学生课后可以自由进出校图书馆。

words.exampleEn: Our school timetable differs from that of last year.
words.exampleZh: 我们学校的课程表和去年不同。

words.meaning: phrv. 合计，共计；phrv. 等同于，相当于；phrv. 发展成，结果是
words.exampleEn: The total cost amounted to three hundred yuan.
words.exampleZh: 总费用合计三百元。

words.meaning: idm. 依次，轮流，逐个；idm. 相应地，转而
words.exampleEn: The students answered the question in turn.
words.exampleZh: 学生们依次回答了这个问题。

words.exampleEn: I happened to meet my old friend at the station.
words.exampleZh: 我在车站碰巧遇到了老朋友。

words.meaning: phrv. (给某人) 打电话；phrv. 使回忆起，使想起
words.exampleEn: Grandma called up my mother early this morning.
words.exampleZh: 奶奶今天一早给妈妈打了电话。

words.exampleEn: People often associate red lights with danger on roads.
words.exampleZh: 人们常把红灯和道路危险联系起来。

words.exampleEn: His headache resulted from a long night of work.
words.exampleZh: 他的头痛是熬了一整夜造成的。

words.exampleEn: No matter how busy he is, he reads every day.
words.exampleZh: 不管他多忙，每天都读书。

words.meaning: usage. (表目的) 为了，以便；因此，所以
words.exampleEn: She speaks slowly so that every child understands her.
words.exampleZh: 她说得慢，以便每个孩子都听懂。

words.exampleEn: Our team aimed at the first prize in the contest.
words.exampleZh: 我们队力求在比赛中拿到一等奖。

words.exampleEn: This big box weighs as much as twenty kilos.
words.exampleZh: 这个大箱子重达二十公斤。

words.exampleEn: We equipped the new lab with ten computers.
words.exampleZh: 我们给新实验室配了十台电脑。

words.exampleEn: The more you read, the more you learn.
words.exampleZh: 你读得越多，学到的就越多。

words.meaning: idm. (希望、愿望等) 实现，成真
words.exampleEn: Her dream of becoming a nurse came true.
words.exampleZh: 她当护士的梦想实现了。

words.exampleEn: Daily practice made a real difference to her English.
words.exampleZh: 每天练习让她的英语明显进步了。

words.exampleEn: Dad took a look at my report card and smiled.
words.exampleZh: 爸爸看了一眼我的成绩单，笑了。

words.meaning: phrv. 依赖…，依靠…；phrv. 信赖…，信任…
words.exampleEn: We rely on the morning bus to get to school.
words.exampleZh: 我们靠早班公交去上学。

words.meaning: collocation. 申请，申请书，申请表
words.exampleEn: Please fill in this application form before Friday.
words.exampleZh: 请在周五前填好这份申请表。

words.exampleEn: With regard to the trip, we need more details.
words.exampleZh: 关于这次旅行，我们还需要更多细节。

words.exampleEn: She carried the glass cups with great care.
words.exampleZh: 她小心翼翼地端着那些玻璃杯。

words.exampleEn: I returned the borrowed books to the library yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 我昨天把借的书还给了图书馆。

words.meaning: phrv. 从…出来；phr. 泄露，被人知道
words.exampleEn: We got out of the taxi near the museum.
words.exampleZh: 我们在博物馆附近下了出租车。

words.meaning: usage. 对…的方法，对…的态度
words.exampleEn: Our teacher found a new approach to teaching grammar.
words.exampleZh: 老师找到了教语法的新方法。

words.meaning: phrv. 建造，搭建；phrv. 张贴，公布；phrv. 提高 (价格等)；提供 (资金等)；phrv. 留某人在家中过夜
words.exampleEn: We put up a small wooden shelf in the kitchen.
words.exampleZh: 我们在厨房里搭了个小木架。

words.meaning: idm. 到达 (某数量、程度等)，多达；idm. 直到，不多于，不迟于；idm. 与…一样高 (或好)；能胜任；idm. 正在干，从事着 (尤指坏事)
words.exampleEn: The small bus carries up to twenty students.
words.exampleZh: 这辆小巴最多能载二十名学生。

words.meaning: usage. 同意做某事；usage. 约定做某事
words.exampleEn: They agreed to help us clean the classroom after school.
words.exampleZh: 他们同意放学后帮我们打扫教室。

words.meaning: idm. 一点也不，完全不；idm. 别客气，不用谢
words.exampleEn: I am not at all tired after the short walk.
words.exampleZh: 短途散步后我一点也不累。

words.meaning: usage. 依赖…的；usage. 取决于…的；usage. 有瘾的
words.exampleEn: Many students are still dependent on their parents for money.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生在金钱上仍依赖父母。

words.exampleEn: We used an old box as a small table.
words.exampleZh: 我们把一个旧箱子当小桌子用。

words.exampleEn: After the experiment, we drew a clear conclusion from the data.
words.exampleZh: 实验后我们根据数据得出了结论。

words.exampleEn: Two nurses took turns watching the sick child at night.
words.exampleZh: 两名护士夜里轮流照看生病的孩子。

words.exampleEn: My uncle invested in a small shop near the station.
words.exampleZh: 我叔叔在车站附近投资了一家小店。

words.exampleEn: I paid for the tickets with my own money.
words.exampleZh: 我用自己的钱付了票钱。

words.exampleEn: The old bridge is in need of urgent repair.
words.exampleZh: 这座旧桥急需修缮。

words.meaning: usage. 对…担心的；usage. 对…感兴趣的，对…关心的
words.exampleEn: Parents are often concerned about their children's safety.
words.exampleZh: 父母常常担心孩子的安全。

words.exampleEn: The train may well be late because of the heavy snow.
words.exampleZh: 因为大雪，火车很可能晚点。

words.exampleEn: This problem is by no means easy for beginners.
words.exampleZh: 这道题对初学者来说决不容易。

words.meaning: usage. 各种各样的某事物
words.exampleEn: The market sells a variety of fresh fruit every morning.
words.exampleZh: 这个市场每天早上卖各种新鲜水果。

words.exampleEn: My sister looked after the baby all afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 我姐姐照看了宝宝一下午。

words.meaning: usage. 给某人看 (或展示) 某物
words.exampleEn: Tom showed his new photo to his classmates.
words.exampleZh: 汤姆把新照片给同学看。

words.meaning: usage. 控告某人…，指责某人…
words.exampleEn: The manager accused him of breaking the office rules.
words.exampleZh: 经理指责他违反了办公室规定。

words.meaning: idm. (在某段时间内) 一直，始终；idm. 经常，总是
words.exampleEn: It rained all the time during our short trip.
words.exampleZh: 我们短暂旅行期间一直在下雨。

words.meaning: usage. 来做某事；usage. 怎么，为什么
words.exampleEn: Neighbors came to help us clean the yard yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 邻居们昨天来帮我们打扫院子。

words.exampleEn: New students quickly adapted to the busy school life.
words.exampleZh: 新生很快适应了忙碌的校园生活。

words.exampleEn: We hope to visit the science museum next weekend.
words.exampleZh: 我们希望下周末参观科学博物馆。

words.exampleEn: He adjusted his plan to the bad weather.
words.exampleZh: 他调整计划以适应糟糕的天气。

words.meaning: usage. 对…的态度，对…的看法
words.exampleEn: Her attitude towards homework changed after the talk.
words.exampleZh: 那次谈话后她对作业的态度变了。

words.meaning: phrv. 积少成多；phrv. 把…加起来
words.exampleEn: Small savings add up to a large sum over time.
words.exampleZh: 小额存款日积月累成一大笔钱。

words.exampleEn: A careless hiker was in trouble on the cold mountain.
words.exampleZh: 粗心的登山者在寒冷的山上陷入困境。

words.exampleEn: She chose tea rather than coffee at breakfast.
words.exampleZh: 早餐时她选了茶而不是咖啡。

words.exampleEn: Workers continued to build the road after the rain.
words.exampleZh: 雨后工人们继续修路。

words.meaning: usage. 要求某物，请求某事
words.exampleEn: He asked for a glass of water at the restaurant.
words.exampleZh: 他在餐厅要了一杯水。

words.exampleEn: The baby was born with a weak heart.
words.exampleZh: 这个婴儿生下来心脏就不好。

words.meaning: usage. 对…小心的，对…谨慎的
words.exampleEn: Be careful with the hot pan on the stove.
words.exampleZh: 小心炉子上的热锅。

words.meaning: usage. 努力做某事，为…而奋斗
words.exampleEn: She struggled to finish the report before the deadline.
words.exampleZh: 她努力在截止日前完成报告。

words.meaning: usage. 对…来说是必不可少的
words.exampleEn: Clean water is essential to good health in summer.
words.exampleZh: 干净的水对夏季健康必不可少。

words.exampleEn: This small town is famous for its sweet apples.
words.exampleZh: 这个小镇因甜苹果而出名。

words.exampleEn: We eat out once in a while on busy days.
words.exampleZh: 忙的时候我们偶尔下馆子。

words.exampleEn: Our new library is located in the quiet north area.
words.exampleZh: 我们的新图书馆位于安静的北区。

words.meaning: phrv. 把…调低，关小；phrv. 拒绝
words.exampleEn: Please turn down the radio a little at night.
words.exampleZh: 晚上请把收音机音量调小一点。

words.exampleEn: Take two pills at a time after each meal.
words.exampleZh: 每餐后每次服两片药。

words.meaning: usage. 位于，坐落于；usage. 存在于，在于
words.exampleEn: A quiet village lies in the green hills.
words.exampleZh: 一座安静的村庄坐落在青山间。

words.exampleEn: Tourists looked around the old square with great interest.
words.exampleZh: 游客们饶有兴致地环视古老广场。

words.meaning: usage. 相对某人而言的优势
words.exampleEn: Tall players have an advantage over short ones in basketball.
words.exampleZh: 打篮球时高个子比矮个子有优势。

words.meaning: usage. 受某人喜爱的，受某人欢迎的
words.exampleEn: This song is popular with young students these days.
words.exampleZh: 这首歌如今很受年轻学生欢迎。

words.meaning: usage. 富含…的，含有大量…的
words.exampleEn: Milk is rich in protein and helps children grow.
words.exampleZh: 牛奶富含蛋白质，有助孩子成长。

words.exampleEn: He finally told the truth about the broken window.
words.exampleZh: 他终于说出了打破窗户的真相。

words.exampleEn: The little boy was unable to reach the top shelf.
words.exampleZh: 小男孩够不到最上面的架子。

words.exampleEn: I called her as soon as I got the news.
words.exampleZh: 我一得到消息就给她打了电话。

words.exampleEn: This old film is worth watching twice with friends.
words.exampleZh: 这部老电影值得和朋友看两遍。

words.exampleEn: Our English class began with a short warm-up song.
words.exampleZh: 我们的英语课以一首热身歌开始。

words.exampleEn: These old keys belong to the front desk.
words.exampleZh: 这些旧钥匙属于前台。

words.exampleEn: Our team aims to finish the project by Friday.
words.exampleZh: 我们团队力求在周五前完成项目。

words.meaning: idm. 既然那样，那样的话
words.exampleEn: In that case, we took the early train instead.
words.exampleZh: 那样的话，我们改乘了早班火车。

words.exampleEn: The teacher pointed out two mistakes in my essay.
words.exampleZh: 老师指出了我作文里的两处错误。

words.meaning: usage. 因…而责怪…，把…归咎于…
words.exampleEn: Don't blame others for your own careless mistake.
words.exampleZh: 别把自己的粗心错误怪到别人头上。

words.meaning: usage. 全神贯注于，集中心思在
words.exampleEn: I cannot concentrate on my book with such loud noise.
words.exampleZh: 这么吵我没法专心看书。

words.meaning: usage. 向…捐献，向…捐助；usage. 促使，是导致…的原因之一；usage. 为…做贡献
words.exampleEn: Many neighbors contributed to the school library fund.
words.exampleZh: 许多邻居向学校图书馆基金捐款。

words.meaning: phrv. 坚持；信守，遵守 (信念、规则等)
words.exampleEn: We stuck to our original plan despite the heavy rain.
words.exampleZh: 尽管下大雨，我们仍坚持原计划。

words.exampleEn: Keep your passport safe at all times during the trip.
words.exampleZh: 旅行期间请始终保管好护照。

words.exampleEn: We discussed the holiday plan with our parents last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和父母讨论了假期计划。

words.exampleEn: Careless driving resulted in a serious accident on the road.
words.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶导致了路上一起严重事故。

words.exampleEn: The teacher divided the class into four small groups.
words.exampleZh: 老师把班级分成四个小组。

words.meaning: usage. 从…进化，自…演变；usage. 从…逐步发展
words.exampleEn: Birds evolved from small dinosaurs millions of years ago.
words.exampleZh: 鸟类在数百万年前由小恐龙进化而来。

words.exampleEn: With the help of a map, we found the small village.
words.exampleZh: 借助地图我们找到了那个小村庄。

words.exampleEn: I cannot put up with the noisy neighbors any more.
words.exampleZh: 我再也无法忍受吵闹的邻居了。

words.exampleEn: This old song reminds me of my happy school days.
words.exampleZh: 这首老歌让我想起快乐的校园时光。

words.meaning: usage. 看，瞧；phrv. (仔细) 检查；phrv. 思考，考虑；phrv. (用某种方式) 看待
words.exampleEn: Look at those beautiful flowers near the garden gate.
words.exampleZh: 瞧瞧花园门口那些漂亮的花。

words.exampleEn: A first-aid box is always on hand in our kitchen.
words.exampleZh: 我们厨房里总备着一个急救箱。

words.meaning: phrv. 把某人牵扯到某事里；usage. 使某人参与 (或介入)
words.exampleEn: Don't involve innocent people in your private quarrel.
words.exampleZh: 别把无关的人卷进你的私人争吵。

words.meaning: phrv. 带某人出去 (到餐馆、剧院等)；phrv. 领到 (贷款、执照、保单等)；phrv. (从银行账户中) 取款；phrv. 毁灭，杀死
words.exampleEn: Dad took us out for dinner on my birthday.
words.exampleZh: 生日那天爸爸带我们出去吃晚饭。

words.exampleEn: I gave my mother a call after lunch today.
words.exampleZh: 今天午饭后我给妈妈打了个电话。

words.exampleEn: A lack of sleep made him tired all morning.
words.exampleZh: 睡眠不足让他一上午都很累。

words.exampleEn: The rainy morning turned into a sunny afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 雨天的早晨变成了晴朗的下午。

words.exampleEn: The box was so heavy that I could not lift it.
words.exampleZh: 箱子太重了，我搬不起来。

words.exampleEn: We never laughed at his strange old coat.
words.exampleZh: 我们从不嘲笑他那件奇怪的旧外套。

words.meaning: usage. 对…感兴趣的，对…关心的；usage. 与…有关的，与…有牵连的
words.exampleEn: Our teacher is concerned with every student's progress.
words.exampleZh: 我们老师关心每个学生的进步。

words.meaning: usage. 有点儿，稍微；usage. 一会儿，短距离
words.exampleEn: I felt a bit nervous before the job interview.
words.exampleZh: 面试前我有点儿紧张。

words.exampleEn: Guests may call the front desk at any time.
words.exampleZh: 客人可以随时给前台打电话。

words.meaning: idm. 而且，更为重要的是
words.exampleEn: What is more, the new phone costs less than before.
words.exampleZh: 而且，这款新手机比以前更便宜。

words.exampleEn: My sister majored in English at college.
words.exampleZh: 我姐姐在大学主修英语。

words.exampleEn: Some boys made fun of his old-fashioned haircut.
words.exampleZh: 几个男孩取笑他过时的发型。

words.meaning: usage. 可用作…，可当…使；usage. 产生…的效果 (或结果)；usage. 担任 (某一职位)
words.exampleEn: This big room serves as our meeting hall on Mondays.
words.exampleZh: 这个大房间周一用作我们的会议室。

words.exampleEn: For example, bananas are cheap and healthy snacks.
words.exampleZh: 例如，香蕉是便宜又健康的零食。

words.exampleEn: Her skill in drawing improved after daily practice.
words.exampleZh: 每天练习后她的绘画技能提高了。

words.meaning: usage. 成功做到，达到目的，办到；usage. 在 (事业等) 方面取得成功
words.exampleEn: We succeeded in finishing the hard task before dark.
words.exampleZh: 我们成功在天黑前完成了难任务。

words.exampleEn: He apologized for the late reply to my email.
words.exampleZh: 他为迟迟未回我邮件道了歉。

words.exampleEn: The notice drew attention to the changed exam date.
words.exampleZh: 通知让大家注意到改了的考试日期。

words.meaning: usage. 与某人争吵 (或争论)
words.exampleEn: I argued with my brother about the TV channel.
words.exampleZh: 我和弟弟为看哪个频道吵了起来。

words.exampleEn: She would rather walk home than wait for a bus.
words.exampleZh: 她宁愿走回家也不愿等公交。

words.exampleEn: The boss arranged for a driver to meet the guest.
words.exampleZh: 老板安排了一名司机去接客人。

words.exampleEn: As usual, Grandpa reads the newspaper after breakfast.
words.exampleZh: 像往常一样，爷爷早饭后看报纸。

words.meaning: phrv. 解决，克服，控制；phrv. 从 (不愉快的经历) 中恢复常态
words.exampleEn: She got over her fear of speaking in public.
words.exampleZh: 她克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

words.exampleEn: Old friends looked back on their happy college years.
words.exampleZh: 老朋友们回首快乐的大学岁月。

words.exampleEn: Farmers struggled with the long dry weather last summer.
words.exampleZh: 去年夏天农民与长期干旱作斗争。

words.meaning: phrv. 出现，露面，如约赶到；phrv. (使) 看得见，显现出来
words.exampleEn: Two guests showed up late at the small party.
words.exampleZh: 两位客人很晚才出现在小聚会上。

words.exampleEn: This small dictionary meets my daily study needs.
words.exampleZh: 这本小词典满足我日常学习需要。

words.exampleEn: We used old boxes for storing winter clothes.
words.exampleZh: 我们用旧箱子存放冬衣。

words.exampleEn: The heavy storm brought about a sudden power cut.
words.exampleZh: 暴风雨造成了突然停电。

words.meaning: collocation. 过去某个时期，曾经
words.exampleEn: At one time, this quiet street was a busy market.
words.exampleZh: 这条安静的街曾经是热闹的市场。

words.exampleEn: She saved money in the hope of buying a bike.
words.exampleZh: 她存钱，希望能买一辆自行车。

words.meaning: idm. 舒适，自由自在，无拘无束
words.exampleEn: Warm tea made the shy guest feel at ease.
words.exampleZh: 热茶让害羞的客人感到自在。

words.exampleEn: His name appears at the bottom of the list.
words.exampleZh: 他的名字出现在名单的底部。

words.meaning: idm. 利用某物 (做某事)；idm. 利用某人，占某人的便宜
words.exampleEn: He took advantage of the quiet morning to study English.
words.exampleZh: 他利用安静的早晨学习英语。

words.meaning: usage. 对某人生气的，对某人愤怒的
words.exampleEn: My mother was angry with me for breaking the cup.
words.exampleZh: 妈妈因为我打碎杯子而生我的气。

words.exampleEn: The dry grass caught fire during the hot afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 干草在炎热的下午着了火。

words.meaning: usage. 对…有益的，对…有利的
words.exampleEn: Fresh vegetables are beneficial to our health.
words.exampleZh: 新鲜蔬菜对我们的健康有益。

words.exampleEn: I am clear about the rules of the game.
words.exampleZh: 我很清楚这项比赛的规则。

words.exampleEn: The shop delivers orders as soon as possible.
words.exampleZh: 这家店尽快配送订单。

words.meaning: phrv. 关掉，截断；phrv. 拐弯，转入另一条路
words.exampleEn: She turned off the light before leaving the room.
words.exampleZh: 她离开房间前把灯关掉了。

words.meaning: phrv. (植物) 长出地面，破土而出；phrv. 被提及，被讨论；phrv. 即将发生；来到，马上备妥；phrv. 走到跟前；接近 (期限)
words.exampleEn: Small plants came up in the field after the rain.
words.exampleZh: 雨后田里长出了小苗。

words.meaning: phrv. 总共是，总计为；phrv. 结果是，表示
words.exampleEn: The three bills add up to fifty dollars.
words.exampleZh: 这三张账单总计五十美元。

words.meaning: usage. 渴望，热衷于；usage. 对…着迷
words.exampleEn: My brother is keen on playing basketball after school.
words.exampleZh: 我弟弟热衷于放学后打篮球。

words.meaning: usage. 与 B 比更喜欢 A
words.exampleEn: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
words.exampleZh: 早晨我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。

words.meaning: idm. 简明恰当的，切中要点的
words.exampleEn: His answer was short and to the point.
words.exampleZh: 他的回答简短而切中要点。

words.meaning: usage. 与…相关联的，与…有联系的
words.exampleEn: Poor sleep is linked to high stress at work.
words.exampleZh: 睡眠差与工作压力大有关联。

words.exampleEn: Guests arrived prior to the start of the show.
words.exampleZh: 客人们在演出开始前就到了。

words.exampleEn: He told a lie about his missing homework.
words.exampleZh: 他关于没交作业的事撒了谎。

words.meaning: phrv. 紧跟着，不离开…；phrv. 持续做，坚持做；phrv. 留在…的记忆里
words.exampleEn: The little boy stuck with his mother in the crowd.
words.exampleZh: 小男孩在人群里紧跟着妈妈。

words.meaning: usage. 对…认真的，对…严肃的
words.exampleEn: She is serious about learning to play the piano.
words.exampleZh: 她对学弹钢琴这件事很认真。

words.meaning: idm. 立即，马上，毫不耽搁
words.exampleEn: We cleaned the classroom right away after lunch.
words.exampleZh: 午饭后我们立刻打扫了教室。

words.exampleEn: Our math teacher is strict with every student.
words.exampleZh: 我们的数学老师对每个学生都严格。

words.meaning: idm. 同时，在同一个时间；idm. 与此同时，然而，不过
words.exampleEn: The two buses arrived at the station at the same time.
words.exampleZh: 两辆公交车同时到站。

words.exampleEn: He never looks down on the new workers.
words.exampleZh: 他从不瞧不起新来的工人。

words.exampleEn: I am tired of the same breakfast every day.
words.exampleZh: 我厌倦了每天一样的早餐。

words.exampleEn: This kind of bird is unique to the island.
words.exampleZh: 这种鸟是这个岛所特有的。

words.meaning: usage. 提醒某人去做某事
words.exampleEn: My mother reminded me to take the medicine after dinner.
words.exampleZh: 妈妈提醒我饭后吃药。

words.meaning: usage. 对某人来说熟悉的
words.exampleEn: This old song is familiar to most students.
words.exampleZh: 这首老歌对多数学生来说很熟悉。

words.exampleEn: The new rule is aimed at reducing waste in the office.
words.exampleZh: 新规定旨在减少办公室的浪费。

words.meaning: phrv. 把…送回，归还；phrv. 使回忆起，使想起；phrv. 恢复，重新使用
words.exampleEn: I brought back the books to the library yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 我昨天把书还回了图书馆。

words.meaning: usage. 值得…的，应该获得…的
words.exampleEn: Her hard work is worthy of great praise.
words.exampleZh: 她的努力值得高度赞扬。

words.exampleEn: The child begged his father to buy a toy.
words.exampleZh: 孩子恳求爸爸给他买个玩具。

words.exampleEn: She broke the school record in the long jump.
words.exampleZh: 她打破了学校的跳远纪录。

words.exampleEn: Our shop does business with a nearby farm.
words.exampleZh: 我们店和附近一家农场做生意。

words.meaning: idm. 把…控制住 (从而不造成损害)
words.exampleEn: Firefighters brought the big fire under control in an hour.
words.exampleZh: 消防员一小时内把大火控制住了。

words.exampleEn: The old wooden house burned down last winter.
words.exampleZh: 那座旧木屋去年冬天烧毁了。

words.meaning: idm. 就某事而言；idm. 在某人看来，就某人而言
words.exampleEn: As far as the price is concerned, this bike is fine.
words.exampleZh: 就价格而言，这辆自行车挺合适。

words.exampleEn: He is away on a trip at the moment.
words.exampleZh: 他目前在外地旅行。

words.exampleEn: I found the old photo by accident in a drawer.
words.exampleZh: 我在抽屉里偶然翻到那张旧照片。

words.exampleEn: He acts as if he is the boss.
words.exampleZh: 他表现得好像自己就是老板。

words.exampleEn: She added a bit of salt to the soup.
words.exampleZh: 她往汤里加了一点点盐。

words.meaning: idm. 比较起来，相比之下；idm. (与…) 相比较
words.exampleEn: By comparison, the blue coat costs much less.
words.exampleZh: 相比之下，那件蓝外套便宜得多。

words.meaning: phrv. (使) 变得更高兴，振奋起来
words.exampleEn: A funny story cheered up the whole class.
words.exampleZh: 一个有趣的故事让全班振奋起来。

words.exampleEn: A doctor convinced him of the need for rest.
words.exampleZh: 医生使他相信了休息的必要性。

words.meaning: usage. (比赛、建筑物等) 对…开放的；usage. 对…心态开放的，乐意接受…的；usage. 待由…决定的
words.exampleEn: The museum is open to visitors on Sundays.
words.exampleZh: 这家博物馆周日对游客开放。

words.exampleEn: My brother corrected a mistake in his homework.
words.exampleZh: 我哥哥改正了作业里的一个错误。

words.exampleEn: The captain set an example for the young players.
words.exampleZh: 队长为年轻队员树立了榜样。

words.exampleEn: Mountain weather is cold at times in winter.
words.exampleZh: 山里的冬天有时天气很冷。

words.exampleEn: We counted on the map during the long trip.
words.exampleZh: 长途旅行中我们靠着这张地图。

words.meaning: phrv. 接通 (电流、煤气等) ，启动
words.exampleEn: He turned on the radio to hear the news.
words.exampleZh: 他打开收音机听新闻。

words.exampleEn: Drivers pay attention to the road signs in fog.
words.exampleZh: 雾天司机要注意路标。

words.exampleEn: She covered the table with a clean white cloth.
words.exampleZh: 她用一块干净白布盖住桌子。

words.meaning: usage. 重视…，认为…具有重要性
words.exampleEn: Our school attaches great importance to daily exercise.
words.exampleZh: 我们学校非常重视日常锻炼。

words.exampleEn: The shy girl dared to speak in front of the class.
words.exampleZh: 那个害羞的女孩敢在全班面前发言。

words.meaning: usage. 寻找，寻求；phrv. 期望，期待，盼望
words.exampleEn: We looked for a cheap hotel near the station.
words.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近找一家便宜旅馆。

words.meaning: idm. 日日夜夜，夜以继日
words.exampleEn: Nurses cared for the sick child day and night.
words.exampleZh: 护士们日夜照料那个生病的孩子。

words.meaning: usage. 不同意 (某人)，不赞成 (某事)
words.exampleEn: I disagreed with my friend about the plan.
words.exampleZh: 关于这个计划我不同意朋友的意见。

words.meaning: usage. 把…当作…对待，把…当…处理
words.exampleEn: The family treated the guest as a close friend.
words.exampleZh: 这家人把客人当作亲密朋友对待。

words.exampleEn: Dozens of students waited outside the library door.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生等在图书馆门外。

words.meaning: phrv. 因…而壮大，从…中得到滋养；phrv. (动物) 以…为食
words.exampleEn: Rumors feed on fear in a small town.
words.exampleZh: 小镇上的谣言因恐惧而滋长。

words.meaning: phrv. 奋力抵抗，还击；phrv. 忍住，抑制住 (尤指情感)
words.exampleEn: The small team fought back and won the game.
words.exampleZh: 这支小队奋力反击并赢得了比赛。

words.meaning: phrv. 赠送，捐赠；phrv. 泄露，暴露
words.exampleEn: We gave away ten books to the village school.
words.exampleZh: 我们把十本书捐给了乡村学校。

words.meaning: phrv. 打垮，击败，使垮台；phrv. 减少，降低；phrv. 使 (飞机) 着陆
words.exampleEn: High costs brought down the small family business.
words.exampleZh: 高成本压垮了这家小家庭企业。

words.exampleEn: The doctor knew the cause for certain after the test.
words.exampleZh: 检查后医生确定无疑地知道了病因。

words.exampleEn: On the other hand, this shirt fits me well.
words.exampleZh: 另一方面，这件衬衫很合我身。

words.meaning: phrv. 占上风，取而代之；phrv. 接任，接替；phrv. 接管
words.exampleEn: Anger took over during the long argument.
words.exampleZh: 长时间争论中怒气占了上风。

words.exampleEn: For one thing, we lack enough money for the trip.
words.exampleZh: 一来，我们没有足够的钱去旅行。

words.meaning: phrv. 赶上，追上；phrv. 通过交谈了解彼此的近况
words.exampleEn: He ran fast to catch up with the group.
words.exampleZh: 他快跑几步赶上了队伍。

words.exampleEn: You had better take an umbrella on a rainy day.
words.exampleZh: 下雨天你最好带把伞。

words.meaning: collocation. 到那时，(某事该发生的) 时间
words.exampleEn: By the time my father came home, dinner was ready.
words.exampleZh: 爸爸到家时晚饭已经准备好了。

words.meaning: phrv. 和某人会晤 (商讨问题等)
words.exampleEn: The manager met with the workers to discuss the plan.
words.exampleZh: 经理和工人们会面商讨计划。

words.meaning: phrv. (在某处附近) 等待，逗留，闲荡
words.exampleEn: Teenagers hung around the shop after school.
words.exampleZh: 放学后少年们在店铺附近闲荡。

words.exampleEn: We had a picnic by the lake last Sunday.
words.exampleZh: 上周日我们在湖边野餐了。

words.exampleEn: I have faith in my close friends.
words.exampleZh: 我信任我的亲密朋友们。

words.meaning: usage. (在空间、时间上) 靠近…的；usage. 快要 (处于某种状态)；usage. 与…亲密的，与…密切的；idm. 几乎是，差不多是；近乎
words.exampleEn: Our house is close to the new subway station.
words.exampleZh: 我们家离新地铁站很近。

words.exampleEn: She prefers reading novels at home on rainy days.
words.exampleZh: 雨天她更喜欢在家读小说。

words.exampleEn: My little sister took a warm bath before bed.
words.exampleZh: 我妹妹睡前洗了个温水澡。

words.exampleEn: He left the house in a hurry this morning.
words.exampleZh: 他今天早上匆忙离开了家。

words.exampleEn: She wrote the note in a rush before the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 会前她匆忙写好了那张便条。

words.meaning: phrv. 走开，离开；phrv. 离家外出 (尤指度假)；phrv. 消失
words.exampleEn: A little dog went away after lunch.
words.exampleZh: 午饭后一只小狗走开了。

words.exampleEn: No sooner did we sit down than the film began.
words.exampleZh: 我们刚坐下电影就开始了。

words.exampleEn: He used a knife to cut the fresh bread.
words.exampleZh: 他用刀切开了新鲜面包。

words.meaning: idm. 现在，此刻；idm. 马上，立即
words.exampleEn: I need a glass of water right now.
words.exampleZh: 我现在需要一杯水。

words.exampleEn: We look forward to the summer holiday every year.
words.exampleZh: 我们每年都盼着暑假。

words.meaning: phrv. 挺过来，熬过来，渡过 (难关)；phrv. (使) 正式通过，获得采纳；phrv. (设法) 处理，完成
words.exampleEn: My family got through the cold winter together.
words.exampleZh: 我们一家人一起熬过了寒冬。

words.exampleEn: I stayed in contact with my cousin abroad.
words.exampleZh: 我和在国外的表亲保持联络。

words.meaning: phrv. 最后结果是，最终成为；phrv. 制造，生产，培养出
words.exampleEn: The quiet boy turned out to be a good singer.
words.exampleZh: 那个安静的男孩结果成了好歌手。

words.exampleEn: In contrast to the noisy city, the village is quiet.
words.exampleZh: 与喧闹的城市相比，村子很安静。

words.meaning: collocation. (指服装) 流行的，时髦的
words.exampleEn: Her red dress is in style this season.
words.exampleZh: 她的红裙子这季很时髦。

words.meaning: phrv. 返回 (某地)；phrv. 回忆起，回到 (原来的话题)；phrv. 追溯到；phrv. 重新开始，重操旧业
words.exampleEn: We went back to the hotel after the show.
words.exampleZh: 演出结束后我们返回了旅馆。

words.meaning: phrv. 认输，投降；phrv. 屈从，让步
words.exampleEn: After a long fight, the team gave in.
words.exampleZh: 经过长时间较量，那队认输了。

words.exampleEn: I am familiar with this old city map.
words.exampleZh: 我对这张旧城市地图很熟悉。

words.meaning: idm. 做出决定，下定决心
words.exampleEn: She made up her mind to study abroad.
words.exampleZh: 她下定决心出国留学。

words.meaning: phrv. 想出 (答案等) ，拿出 (钱款等)
words.exampleEn: A student came up with a clever answer in class.
words.exampleZh: 一个学生在课堂上想出了巧妙答案。

words.meaning: collocation. 较长的一段时间，好些时候
words.exampleEn: We waited for some time at the bus stop.
words.exampleZh: 我们在公交站等了好些时候。

words.meaning: idm. 在某人面前；idm. 在…的情况下
words.exampleEn: My little brother felt nervous in the presence of the strict teacher.
words.exampleZh: 在严厉的老师面前我弟弟很紧张。

words.meaning: n. 工作邀约，工作机会
words.exampleEn: She received a job offer from a big company.
words.exampleZh: 她收到了一家大公司的工作邀约。

words.exampleEn: My uncle is in business in the clothing trade.
words.exampleZh: 我叔叔在服装行业经商。

words.meaning: phrv. 超过 (或超出) 某事
words.exampleEn: The final cost went beyond our small budget.
words.exampleZh: 最终花费超出了我们微薄的预算。

words.exampleEn: We learned a great deal from that short trip.
words.exampleZh: 那次短途旅行让我们学到很多。

words.meaning: phrv. 请…做，让…参与；phrv. 吸引，引入；phrv. 赚得，挣
words.exampleEn: The manager brought in an expert to fix it.
words.exampleZh: 经理请来一位专家修理它。

words.meaning: phrv. 根据 (建议、信息等) 行事；usage. 对…有作用，有影响
words.exampleEn: She acted on the doctor's advice at once.
words.exampleZh: 她立刻按医生的建议行事。

words.meaning: idm. 缓慢地，逐渐地，一点一点地
words.exampleEn: Little by little, the child learned to swim.
words.exampleZh: 这孩子一点一点地学会了游泳。

words.exampleEn: We lost our way in the dark forest.
words.exampleZh: 我们在幽暗的森林里迷了路。

words.exampleEn: During class, one student made a helpful suggestion.
words.exampleZh: 课堂上一名学生提出了有益的建议。

words.meaning: usage. 将 A 和 B 作比较；usage. 认为 A 与 B 相似，将 A 比作 B
words.exampleEn: Buyers often compare a new car to older models.
words.exampleZh: 买车人常把新车与旧款车型比较。

words.meaning: phrv. 打开，翻开；(使) 张开，裂开；phrv. (使) 出现，(使) 产生；phrv. 开门营业；开张，开业
words.exampleEn: He opened up the old map on the table.
words.exampleZh: 他把那张旧地图摊开在桌上。

words.meaning: idm. 把自己的意思表达清楚
words.exampleEn: With simple words, I made myself understood.
words.exampleZh: 我用简单的话把意思表达清楚了。

words.meaning: phrv. (时间) 流逝，过去；phrv. 遵循 (或依照) 某事
words.exampleEn: The long winter months went by slowly.
words.exampleZh: 漫长的冬日一天天过去了。

words.exampleEn: My uncle earns a living by repairing bikes.
words.exampleZh: 我叔叔靠修自行车谋生。

words.meaning: idm. (尤指在商店) 上市，出售；idm. 折价销售，减价出售
words.exampleEn: The new phones are on sale in most shops.
words.exampleZh: 新手机已在多数商店上市销售。

words.exampleEn: A local paper printed a comment on the new film.
words.exampleZh: 一家本地报纸刊登了对这部新片的评论。

words.meaning: idm. 总的说来，大体上，基本上
words.exampleEn: On the whole, the trip was safe and fun.
words.exampleZh: 总的说来，这趟旅行安全又有趣。

words.meaning: idm. 在…上面，在…顶部；idm. 除…之外；idm. 紧挨着，与…紧靠着；idm. 控制着，掌握着
words.exampleEn: Snow lay on top of the low wall.
words.exampleZh: 积雪覆盖在低矮的墙顶上。

words.exampleEn: Our neighbors are on vacation by the sea.
words.exampleZh: 我们的邻居正在海边度假。

words.meaning: usage. 把…固定在…上，把…附在…上；usage. 与…有关联，使与…有联系
words.exampleEn: I attached a note to the front door.
words.exampleZh: 我在前门上贴了一张便条。

words.exampleEn: The police looked into the strange noise last night.
words.exampleZh: 警方调查了昨晚那奇怪的响声。

words.exampleEn: We forgot about the old promise years ago.
words.exampleZh: 我们多年前就不再想那个旧约定了。

words.meaning: phrv. 适用于；phrv. 被…所吸引；phrv. 选择某物；phrv. 努力争取
words.exampleEn: This rule goes for every student in class.
words.exampleZh: 这条规定适用于班上的每名学生。

words.exampleEn: The small town has ten shops or so.
words.exampleZh: 这个小镇大约有十家店铺。

words.meaning: phrv. 发出，放出 (气味、热、光等)
words.exampleEn: Wet wood gave off thick smoke during the fire.
words.exampleZh: 湿木头在火中冒出浓烟。

words.exampleEn: For the time being, we share one small room.
words.exampleZh: 目前我们暂时合住一间小屋。

words.meaning: usage. 以…对待，以…看待；usage. 以…医治，用…治疗；usage. 用 (化学物质或反应) 处理
words.exampleEn: The nurse treated the old man with great care.
words.exampleZh: 护士非常细心地对待那位老人。

words.exampleEn: My little son asked that question over and over.
words.exampleZh: 我的小儿子一再问那个问题。

words.exampleEn: Owing to heavy rain, the match started late.
words.exampleZh: 由于大雨，比赛开始得晚了。

words.meaning: phrv. 是…的意思，代表；phrv. 支持，主张；phrv. 容忍，忍受
words.exampleEn: Three stars stand for the top quality here.
words.exampleZh: 三颗星在这里代表最高品质。

words.exampleEn: We pretty much finished the work by noon.
words.exampleZh: 到中午我们差不多完成了工作。

words.meaning: idm. 向某人施压 (做某事)
words.exampleEn: My boss put pressure on me to finish early.
words.exampleZh: 老板向我施压催我早点完工。

words.meaning: usage. 去参加 (某项活动或运动)
words.exampleEn: Some colleagues went for a swim after work.
words.exampleZh: 几位同事下班后去游了泳。

words.exampleEn: I remember locking the door this morning.
words.exampleZh: 我记得今天早上锁过门。

words.meaning: phrv. 向…求助 (或寻求指教等)；phrv. 转向，改用
words.exampleEn: For advice, I often turned to my father.
words.exampleZh: 需要建议时我常向父亲求助。

words.exampleEn: Something is wrong with the kitchen light.
words.exampleZh: 厨房的灯出了点毛病。

words.exampleEn: We never resort to shouting during an argument.
words.exampleZh: 争吵时我们从不诉诸大喊大叫。

words.exampleEn: I save for a new bike every month.
words.exampleZh: 我每月为一辆新自行车攒钱。

words.meaning: phrv. 遭遇，经历 (不愉快的事)
words.exampleEn: Our plan met with many difficulties at first.
words.exampleZh: 我们的计划起初遇到了许多困难。

words.meaning: phrv. (音乐会、体育比赛等的票) 售完；phrv. 卖完，售空，售罄 (某种商品等)；phrv. 出售 (财产、企业等)
words.exampleEn: All the concert tickets sold out in one hour.
words.exampleZh: 音乐会的票一小时内就售完了。

words.exampleEn: Of course, I remember our first day together.
words.exampleZh: 当然，我记得我们共度的第一天。

words.meaning: phrv. 舒适地坐下 (或躺下)；phrv. (尤指结婚或买房后) 安顿下来；phrv. (使某人) 安静下来，平静下来
words.exampleEn: Grandpa settled down by the warm fire.
words.exampleZh: 爷爷在温暖的炉火旁舒舒服服坐下。

words.meaning: phrv. 加入某组织，从事某职业；phrv. 开始，进入 (某种状态或情况)；phrv. 详细解释，详细描述；phrv. (金钱、时间、精力等) 投入某事
words.exampleEn: After college, my sister went into teaching.
words.exampleZh: 大学毕业后我姐姐当了老师。

words.exampleEn: That corner shop closed down last winter.
words.exampleZh: 街角那家店去年冬天倒闭了。

words.exampleEn: We shook off our fear and went in.
words.exampleZh: 我们摆脱恐惧走了进去。

words.exampleEn: Shortly after lunch, the guests left together.
words.exampleZh: 午饭后不久客人们就一起离开了。

words.meaning: phrv. 使显现，使表现出；phrv. 生产，出版
words.exampleEn: Sunlight brought out the red in the leaves.
words.exampleZh: 阳光让叶子的红色显现出来。

words.exampleEn: Morning buses are convenient for early workers.
words.exampleZh: 早班公交对清早上班的人很方便。

words.exampleEn: The baby smiled at the friendly stranger.
words.exampleZh: 婴儿冲那位友善的陌生人笑了。

words.exampleEn: Mum switched off the TV before dinner.
words.exampleZh: 妈妈晚饭前关掉了电视。

words.exampleEn: From time to time, we visit the old library.
words.exampleZh: 我们偶尔会去那座旧图书馆。

words.exampleEn: After supper, they took a walk along the river.
words.exampleZh: 晚饭后他们沿河散了散步。

words.meaning: phrv. 发生；phrv. (形势等) 继续下去；phrv. (常指短暂停顿后) 继续说；phrv. 继续做 (某事)
words.exampleEn: Something odd went on at the office.
words.exampleZh: 办公室里发生了些奇怪的事。

words.exampleEn: Heavy rain gave rise to a sudden flood.
words.exampleZh: 暴雨引发了一场突发的洪水。

words.meaning: phrv. 当心，提防；phrv. 留心寻觅；phrv. 关照，考虑…的利益
words.exampleEn: Drivers look out for ice on this bridge.
words.exampleZh: 司机在这座桥上要当心结冰。

words.meaning: idm. (用于安慰) 没关系，不要紧；idm. (表示并不重要) 没关系，无所谓；idm. (因为某事是次要的所以) 先别管
words.exampleEn: Never mind, the next bus comes in ten minutes.
words.exampleZh: 没关系，下一班公交十分钟后就到。

words.exampleEn: The school took steps to keep students safe.
words.exampleZh: 学校采取措施保障学生安全。

words.exampleEn: We took the weather into consideration before the picnic.
words.exampleZh: 野餐前我们把天气情况考虑在内。

words.meaning: phrv. 用完，耗尽；phrv. 停止运行，停止运转；phrv. 分发，散发；公布，宣布；phrv. 发出，放出 (气味、热、光等)
words.exampleEn: The batteries gave out during the long trip.
words.exampleZh: 长途旅行中电池耗尽了。

words.exampleEn: Many children take daily meals for granted.
words.exampleZh: 许多孩子把一日三餐当作理所当然。

words.exampleEn: Bread is made from wheat flour and water.
words.exampleZh: 面包是由小麦粉和水做成的。

words.meaning: idm. 也就是说，换句话说
words.exampleEn: That is to say, we need two more days.
words.exampleZh: 也就是说，我们还需要两天时间。

words.exampleEn: Now that the rain stopped, we left the house.
words.exampleZh: 既然雨停了，我们就出了门。

words.meaning: phrv. 与…做生意；phrv. 处理，应付；phrv. 涉及，关于
words.exampleEn: Our farm deals with a big food company.
words.exampleZh: 我们农场和一家大食品公司有生意往来。

words.exampleEn: Our family went on a short trip last weekend.
words.exampleZh: 上周末我们全家去短途旅行了。

words.meaning: phrv. 占用 (时间)，占据 (空间)；phrv. (尤指为消遣) 学着做；开始从事；phrv. 继续 (他人未完成的事)；phrv. 接受 (建议或能得到的东西)
words.exampleEn: This big desk takes up half my room.
words.exampleZh: 这张大桌子占了我房间一半地方。

words.exampleEn: Many guests were dissatisfied with the cold food.
words.exampleZh: 许多客人对冷掉的食物不满意。

words.exampleEn: I forgot paying the bill and paid twice.
words.exampleZh: 我忘了已付过账，结果付了两次。

words.meaning: phrv. 砍倒 (树)；phrv. 削减，缩小 (尺寸、数量或数目)
words.exampleEn: Workers cut down the dead tree yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 工人们昨天砍倒了那棵枯树。

words.meaning: usage. 为…而设计的，旨在，目的是
words.exampleEn: This app is designed to save busy students time.
words.exampleZh: 这款应用旨在帮忙碌的学生省时间。

words.meaning: usage. 将 A 和 B 作比较
words.exampleEn: The teacher compared my essay with the model one.
words.exampleZh: 老师把我的作文和范文作了比较。

words.meaning: usage. 面临，必须对付 (某情况)
words.exampleEn: Our team was faced with a hard choice.
words.exampleZh: 我们团队面临着一个艰难的抉择。

words.exampleEn: Two boys took the tools without permission.
words.exampleZh: 两个男孩擅自拿走了工具。

words.exampleEn: This old bridge is made of large stones.
words.exampleZh: 这座旧桥是用大石块建成的。

words.meaning: idm. 顺便提一下，捎带说一声
words.exampleEn: By the way, the library closes at six.
words.exampleZh: 顺便说一下，图书馆六点关门。

words.exampleEn: Three new members were admitted to the club.
words.exampleZh: 三名新成员获准加入这个社团。

words.meaning: phrv. (尤指失去后偶然) 被发现；phrv. (人) 到达，来到，露面；phrv. (机会) 偶然出现，到来；phrv. 开大，调高 (音量、热量等)
words.exampleEn: My lost keys turned up under the sofa.
words.exampleZh: 我丢的钥匙在沙发底下找到了。

words.meaning: usage. 对…作出评论，就…发表意见
words.exampleEn: The manager refused to comment on the rumor.
words.exampleZh: 经理拒绝就这则传言发表评论。

words.meaning: phrv. (完成某事后) 接着做另一事
words.exampleEn: After lunch, we went on to clean the yard.
words.exampleZh: 午饭后我们接着去打扫院子。

words.exampleEn: I had no time to read the newspaper today.
words.exampleZh: 我今天没时间看报纸。

words.exampleEn: We used up all the milk this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天早上我们把牛奶全喝光了。

words.exampleEn: Old classmates got together at a small restaurant.
words.exampleZh: 老同学们在一家小餐馆聚了聚。

words.exampleEn: My father went abroad on business last week.
words.exampleZh: 我父亲上周因公出国了。

words.meaning: idm. 最重要的是，尤其是
words.exampleEn: Above all, the job needs patience and care.
words.exampleZh: 最重要的是，这份工作需要耐心和细心。

words.exampleEn: When it comes to cooking, Mom knows best.
words.exampleZh: 说到做饭，妈妈最在行。

words.meaning: phrv. (与…) 齐步前进，并驾齐驱；phrv. 熟悉，了解 (消息、形势等)；phrv. 继续支付，继续做
words.exampleEn: We walked fast to keep up with the guide.
words.exampleZh: 我们走快些好跟上导游。

words.exampleEn: The little boy was made to clean his room.
words.exampleZh: 那个小男孩被迫打扫自己的房间。

words.exampleEn: This place is known as a quiet fishing village.
words.exampleZh: 这地方被称作安静的渔村。

words.exampleEn: In terms of price, this coat is a bargain.
words.exampleZh: 就价格而言，这件外套很划算。

words.meaning: phrv. 出门参加社交活动，外出交际；phrv. (火或灯光) 熄灭；phrv. 过时，不再流行
words.exampleEn: My roommates went out with friends last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚我的室友和朋友们出去玩了。

words.meaning: phrv. 抚养，养育，教养；phrv. 提出 (讨论等)
words.exampleEn: My aunt brought up three children alone.
words.exampleZh: 我姑姑独自抚养了三个孩子。

words.meaning: phrv. (比其他类似的人或物) 出色；phrv. 引人注目，显眼
words.exampleEn: One student stood out among the ten singers.
words.exampleZh: 十名歌手中有一人格外出色。

words.exampleEn: The doctor looked over the cut on my hand.
words.exampleZh: 医生检查了我手上的伤口。

words.meaning: idm. 代表某人；idm. 为了某人的利益
words.exampleEn: Our monitor spoke on behalf of the whole class.
words.exampleZh: 班长代表全班同学发了言。

words.exampleEn: In spite of the wind, we finished the game.
words.exampleZh: 尽管有风，我们还是打完了比赛。

words.meaning: collocation. 乘飞机，通过航空途径
words.exampleEn: We sent the medicine by air to the island.
words.exampleZh: 我们把药品空运到了那座岛上。

words.meaning: phrv. 把某物归还给某人；phrv. 使恢复，使重新获得
words.exampleEn: I gave my friend back the borrowed book.
words.exampleZh: 我把借来的书还给了朋友。

words.meaning: idm. (机器) 发生故障，出毛病；idm. 出现问题，遇到困难；idm. 犯错误，做错事，搞错
words.exampleEn: Our washing machine went wrong last week.
words.exampleZh: 我们的洗衣机上周出了故障。

words.exampleEn: The teacher permitted us to leave the classroom early.
words.exampleZh: 老师准许我们提前离开教室。

words.exampleEn: Our team is made up of six young volunteers.
words.exampleZh: 我们队由六名年轻志愿者组成。

words.exampleEn: Good parents communicate with their children every evening.
words.exampleZh: 好父母每天傍晚都与孩子交流。
