words.exampleEn: Daily habits have a big impact on our health.
words.exampleZh: 日常习惯对我们的健康有很大影响。

words.meaning: phrv. 仔细检查 (或审查)；phrv. 反复研究，仔细琢磨；phrv. 从一处到 (另一处)
words.exampleEn: She went over the report twice before the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 她在会议前把报告仔细检查了两遍。

words.exampleEn: Many students took a writing course last summer.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生去年夏天参加了一门写作课。

words.meaning: usage. 开始做 (或使用) ，着手处理
words.exampleEn: He started on his homework right after dinner.
words.exampleZh: 晚饭后他立刻开始做家庭作业。

words.exampleEn: It is advisable to book tickets early for the trip.
words.exampleZh: 提前为旅行订票是明智的。

words.meaning: phr. 除…以外；phr. 除了…还
words.exampleEn: Apart from a few errors, the essay was excellent.
words.exampleZh: 除了几处错误，这篇文章很出色。

words.exampleEn: We sat in a traffic jam for nearly an hour.
words.exampleZh: 我们在堵车中等了将近一小时。

words.exampleEn: We ran to the station and arrived just in time.
words.exampleZh: 我们跑到车站，正好及时赶到。

words.exampleEn: It is convenient to pay with a phone here.
words.exampleZh: 在这里用手机付款很方便。

words.meaning: collocation. 在工作，在上班；idm. 起作用；idm. 忙着 (做某事)
words.exampleEn: My father is at work until six every day.
words.exampleZh: 我父亲每天上班到六点。

words.exampleEn: Most neighbors were opposed to the new factory plan.
words.exampleZh: 多数邻居都反对新工厂的计划。

words.meaning: idm. 获得成功；idm. 准时到达，赶上；idm. 能够出席 (或到场)；idm. 幸免于难，渡过难关
words.exampleEn: After years of practice, he finally made it.
words.exampleZh: 经过多年努力，他终于获得了成功。

words.exampleEn: The kids ran back and forth across the small yard.
words.exampleZh: 孩子们在小院里来回跑个不停。

words.meaning: collocation. (数量或水平) 在上升，在增长
words.exampleEn: House prices are on the rise in this area.
words.exampleZh: 这一地区的房价正在上涨。

words.meaning: phrv. 加大，加强，逐渐增多；phrv. 增强…的体质，使更加强壮；phrv. 创建，开发；phrv. 使…增高，使…增强
words.exampleEn: Tension built up during the long wait.
words.exampleZh: 漫长等待中紧张气氛逐渐增强。

words.meaning: phrv. (法律、合同等正式) 通过，达成；phrv. 仔细察看；(反复地) 详细研究；phrv. 执行某行动，履行某程序；phrv. 经历，遭受；通过 (障碍、测试)
words.exampleEn: The new law went through after a long debate.
words.exampleZh: 新法律经过长时间辩论后获得通过。

words.exampleEn: This small town is known for its sweet apples.
words.exampleZh: 这个小镇以香甜的苹果闻名。

words.exampleEn: The shop sells a wide range of cheap notebooks.
words.exampleZh: 这家店出售一系列便宜的笔记本。

words.meaning: usage. 区分 A 和 B
words.exampleEn: Children learn to distinguish right from wrong early.
words.exampleZh: 孩子们很早就学会区分对与错。

words.exampleEn: The cheap phone proved to be a good buy.
words.exampleZh: 这部便宜手机结果证明很划算。

words.exampleEn: His question had to do with the final exam.
words.exampleZh: 他的问题与期末考试有关。

words.meaning: phrv. 切掉，割掉，砍掉，剪掉；phrv. 阻碍，阻挡；phrv. 使…与外界隔绝
words.exampleEn: She cut off the dry branches from the tree.
words.exampleZh: 她把树上的枯枝剪掉了。

words.meaning: usage. 出发，动身；usage. 以…起步 (或起家)，起初是；phrv. 开始 (某工作、某一重要时期)；phrv. 最初想要，起先打算
words.exampleEn: We started out early to catch the first bus.
words.exampleZh: 我们一早动身去赶首班公交车。

words.meaning: usage. 申请 (工作、学校、许可等)
words.exampleEn: He applied for a job at the local library.
words.exampleZh: 他申请了当地图书馆的一份工作。

words.exampleEn: I forgot to lock the door this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天早上我忘了锁门。

words.meaning: usage. (因有顾虑而) 不愿做某事
words.exampleEn: Many students hesitate to ask questions in class.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生不愿在课堂上提问。

words.meaning: idm. 不可能，决不，没门儿
words.exampleEn: No way, I don't believe that silly story.
words.exampleZh: 没门儿，我才不信那个荒唐说法。

words.exampleEn: My uncle was out of work for six months.
words.exampleZh: 我叔叔失业了六个月。

words.exampleEn: They turned the old barn into a small cafe.
words.exampleZh: 他们把旧谷仓改成了一间小咖啡馆。

words.meaning: phrv. 形成，构成；编造 (故事等)；phrv. 补上，补偿；化妆，上妆；phrv. 和好，和解
words.exampleEn: Girls make up half of our reading club.
words.exampleZh: 女生占我们读书俱乐部的一半。

words.meaning: idm. 决不，绝对不，一点也不
words.exampleEn: The long movie was anything but boring.
words.exampleZh: 这部冗长的电影一点也不无聊。

words.meaning: phrv. (在词典、参考书中) 查阅，查检
words.exampleEn: I looked up this new word in my dictionary.
words.exampleZh: 我在词典里查了这个新单词。

words.meaning: phrv. 被兴建，被建造；phrv. (剧院幕布) 升起；phrv. (物价等) 上涨，(温度等) 上升
words.exampleEn: New apartment blocks went up near the river last year.
words.exampleZh: 去年河边建起了新的公寓楼。

words.exampleEn: We waited for ages at the crowded bus stop.
words.exampleZh: 我们在拥挤的车站等了很久。

words.meaning: usage. 观点，看法，意见；usage. 视角
words.exampleEn: From my point of view, the plan needs more time.
words.exampleZh: 依我看，这个计划还需要更多时间。

words.meaning: phrv. 从…中获得 (快乐、益处等)；phrv. 从…中提取
words.exampleEn: She derives great pleasure from reading short poems.
words.exampleZh: 她从读短诗中获得很大乐趣。

words.exampleEn: He concluded the truth from the old letters.
words.exampleZh: 他从那些旧信件中得出了结论。

words.meaning: usage. 对…全心全意的，对…忠诚的；usage. 热衷的，致力于…的
words.exampleEn: The old nurse is devoted to her patients.
words.exampleZh: 这位老护士对病人全心全意。

words.meaning: collocation. 在空中；idm. 在传播中，可感觉到
words.exampleEn: A red kite floated high in the air.
words.exampleZh: 一只红风筝高高飘在空中。

words.exampleEn: The doctor brought the sick baby back to life.
words.exampleZh: 医生让生病的婴儿活了过来。

words.exampleEn: He gave up smoking for his family's sake.
words.exampleZh: 为了家人他放弃了吸烟。

words.exampleEn: The train arrived on time despite the heavy rain.
words.exampleZh: 尽管下大雨，火车还是准时到达。

words.exampleEn: It started to rain during our afternoon picnic.
words.exampleZh: 下午野餐时天开始下起雨来。

words.exampleEn: We gained a lot from that short training course.
words.exampleZh: 我们从那门短期培训课程中受益良多。

words.exampleEn: A good rest made up for the lost sleep.
words.exampleZh: 好好睡一觉弥补了缺失的睡眠。

words.exampleEn: The team worked on a better design all week.
words.exampleZh: 团队整周都致力于改进设计。

words.exampleEn: Everything went well at the job interview yesterday.
words.exampleZh: 昨天的工作面试一切进展顺利。

words.meaning: usage. 对…的损坏；usage. 对 (情感、精神等的) 伤害
words.exampleEn: The storm caused serious damage to the old roof.
words.exampleZh: 暴风雨对旧屋顶造成了严重损坏。

words.meaning: idm. 认真对待…，把…看得很重要
words.exampleEn: She took my advice seriously during the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 会议期间她认真对待了我的建议。

words.exampleEn: We decided on a blue sofa for the living room.
words.exampleZh: 我们为客厅选定了一张蓝色沙发。

words.meaning: usage. 把…捐赠给 (慈善机构)；usage. 向…献 (血)，向…捐献 (器官)
words.exampleEn: She donated her old books to the village library.
words.exampleZh: 她把旧书捐给了村里的图书馆。

words.meaning: usage. (在从 A 到 B 的范围内) 变化；usage. 包括 (从 A 到 B 的) 各类事物
words.exampleEn: Prices range from ten to fifty dollars in this shop.
words.exampleZh: 这家店的价格从十美元到五十美元不等。

words.exampleEn: Few people know of this quiet little restaurant.
words.exampleZh: 很少有人知道这家安静的小餐馆。

words.meaning: usage. 对…满意的 (或满足的)
words.exampleEn: The teacher was satisfied with my short essay.
words.exampleZh: 老师对我的短文很满意。

words.exampleEn: He applied to three colleges last autumn.
words.exampleZh: 去年秋天他向三所大学递交了申请。

words.exampleEn: Scientists define this gas as a clean fuel.
words.exampleZh: 科学家把这种气体定义为清洁燃料。

words.exampleEn: Many students use public transportation to get to school.
words.exampleZh: 许多学生乘公共交通工具上学。

words.exampleEn: You ought to drink more water in hot weather.
words.exampleZh: 大热天你应当多喝水。

words.exampleEn: My grandmother is fond of quiet country mornings.
words.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜爱乡村宁静的清晨。

words.exampleEn: We ate out at a small noodle shop last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在外面一家小面馆吃饭。

words.meaning: usage. 参与…的，与…有密切关联的
words.exampleEn: He was involved in the school sports meeting last week.
words.exampleZh: 上周他参与了学校的运动会。

words.exampleEn: Grandpa made the empty box into a toy house.
words.exampleZh: 爷爷把空盒子变成了一间玩具小屋。

words.exampleEn: If only I had a bike of my own.
words.exampleZh: 要是我有一辆自己的自行车就好了。

words.exampleEn: In short, the trip was cheap and full of fun.
words.exampleZh: 简而言之，这趟旅行既便宜又有趣。

words.exampleEn: Our lesson started with a simple review quiz.
words.exampleZh: 我们的课以一次简单的复习测验开始。

words.meaning: phrv. 锻炼身体，做运动；phrv. 进展顺利；计算，算出；phrv. 找…的答案，解决；计划，思考；phrv. (费用或数量) 算下来是
words.exampleEn: He works out at the gym twice every week.
words.exampleZh: 他每周在健身房锻炼两次。

words.exampleEn: We inferred his mood from the tone of his voice.
words.exampleZh: 我们从他说话的语气推断出他的心情。

words.meaning: usage. 能胜任…的，有…能力的
words.exampleEn: He is capable of hard work under pressure.
words.exampleZh: 他能胜任压力下的艰苦工作。

words.meaning: phrv. (把…) 打扫干净；phrv. 清理，整顿；phrv. 赢钱，赚大钱，发财
words.exampleEn: We cleaned up the kitchen after the big dinner.
words.exampleZh: 丰盛的晚餐后我们把厨房打扫干净。

words.exampleEn: Thanks to your help, we finished the work early.
words.exampleZh: 幸亏有你帮忙，我们提前完成了工作。

words.meaning: phrv. 从…中得到，从…中获得；usage. 从…中得出，从…中推断出；usage. 从…支取，从…取钱
words.exampleEn: She drew great comfort from her friend's kind letter.
words.exampleZh: 她从朋友亲切的信中得到了极大安慰。

words.meaning: usage. 成功做到，设法完成，能够对付
words.exampleEn: We managed to catch the last bus home last night.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚我们设法赶上了末班公交车。

words.meaning: usage. 适合…的，对…来说恰当的
words.exampleEn: This quiet room is suitable for a small child.
words.exampleZh: 这个安静的房间很适合小孩。

words.meaning: phrv. 迅速出现，突然兴起
words.exampleEn: Small shops sprang up along the new road last year.
words.exampleZh: 去年新路沿线迅速冒出了许多小店。

words.exampleEn: Heavy rain led to a serious flood in the village.
words.exampleZh: 大雨导致村子里发生了严重洪灾。

words.exampleEn: He lost his temper over a tiny mistake.
words.exampleZh: 他因为一个小失误发了脾气。

words.exampleEn: The coach punished the player for being late again.
words.exampleZh: 教练因那名队员再次迟到而惩罚了他。

words.exampleEn: Her job is closely related to public health.
words.exampleZh: 她的工作与公共卫生密切相关。

words.meaning: usage. 依恋…的，爱慕…的；usage. 附属于…的，为…工作的；usage. 为…所附的
words.exampleEn: The little girl is deeply attached to her old doll.
words.exampleZh: 小女孩十分依恋她的旧布娃娃。

words.meaning: usage. 过时的，缺乏新信息的；usage. 失效的，过期的
words.exampleEn: This old map is completely out of date now.
words.exampleZh: 这张旧地图现在已经完全过时了。

words.meaning: usage. 准备好的，为…做好准备
words.exampleEn: We were well prepared for the sudden heavy snow.
words.exampleZh: 我们为突如其来的大雪做好了准备。

words.exampleEn: I am grateful to my neighbor for the hot meal.
words.exampleZh: 我对邻居给的那顿热饭心存感激。

words.exampleEn: He coped with the heavy workload without any complaint.
words.exampleZh: 他毫无怨言地应对了繁重的工作量。

words.exampleEn: Careless drivers are bound to cause an accident.
words.exampleZh: 粗心的司机一定会出事故。

words.meaning: phrv. 退出，不再参加；phrv. 退学，辍学
words.exampleEn: He dropped out of the race because of a bad cold.
words.exampleZh: 他因为重感冒退出了比赛。

words.exampleEn: Too much sugar is harmful to young children's teeth.
words.exampleZh: 太多糖对小孩的牙齿有害。

words.exampleEn: The plan is useful in that it saves a lot of time.
words.exampleZh: 这个计划很有用，因为它节省大量时间。

words.meaning: usage. 下定决心做…的，决意做…的
words.exampleEn: He was determined to pass the driving test.
words.exampleZh: 他下定决心要通过驾照考试。

words.exampleEn: A good sense of humor helps people make friends.
words.exampleZh: 良好的幽默感有助于人们交到朋友。
